Ekyawandiikibwa ekirala ye Yokaana 5:24: “Mazima, mazima, mbagamba nti: Awulira ekigambo kyange, n’akkiriza oyo eyantuma, alina obulamu obutaggwaawo, so tajja kusalirwa ‘musango,’” (enkyusa empya bw’egamba), “wabula avudde mu kufa ne yingira mu bulamu.” Abantu abamu bagamba nti tosobola kumanya okutuusa lw’oliba mu maaso g’entebe enkulu enjeru ey’Omusango oba mulokole oba nedda. Naye, munnange omwagalwa, obulamu bwo bwe buba bukwekeddwa ne Kristo mu Katonda, tojja kuyingira musango olw’ebibi byo. Tuyinza okuyingira omusango olw’empeera. Kino kiyigirizibwa kaati awo mukama we yabala n’omuweereza eyaweebwa ttalanta ttaano, n’aleeta endala ttaano ng’agamba nti, “Mukama wange, wampa ttalanta ttaano; laba, nfunye endala ttaano okuzeeyongerako.” Mukama we n’amugamba nti, “Weebale, omuweereza omulungi era omwesigwa: obadde mwesigwa mu bintu bitono; nnaakufuula omufuzi w’ebintu bingi; yingira mu ssanyu lya mukama wo.” (Matayo 25:20, 21.) Tulisalirwa omusango olw’obuwanika bwaffe. Ekyo kye kimu; naye obulokozi—obulamu obutaggwaawo—kirala. Katonda anaasaba okusasulwa kw’ebbanja emirundi ebiri lye Kristo yasasula ku lwaffe? Kristo bw’yeetikka ebibi byange mu mubiri gwe ku muti, nange nnina okubivunaanibwa? Isaaya atubuulira nti, “Yafumitibwa olw’ebyonoono byaffe; yabetentebwa olw’obutali butuukirivu bwaffe; ekibonerezo eky’emirembe gyaffe kyali ku ye: era olw’ebiwundu bye tuwonyezebwa.” Mu Abaruumi 4:25, tusoma nti: “Yaweebwayo olw’ebyonoono byaffe, era n’azuukizibwa olw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwaffe.” Ka tukkirize, tulyoke tuganyulwe omulimu gwe ogumaliridde. Ate mu Yokaana 10:9: “Nze mulyango: omuntu yenna bw’ayingira ku bwange alirokolebwa, era aliyingira n’afuluma, n’alaba amagoba.” Ekyo kye kisuubizo. Ne mu lunyiriri olw’amakumi abiri mu musanvu, “Endiga zange ziwulira eddoboozi lyange; era mmanyi, era zingoberera. Era nziwa obulamu obutaggwaawo; so tezirizikirira emirembe gyonna, so tewali muntu alizisikula mu mukono gwange. Kitange eyanziwa ye asinga bonna; so tewali ayinza kubasikula mu mukono gwa Kitange.” Lowooza ekyo! Kitaffe, Omwana, n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, beemalirira okutukuuma. Olaba nga si Kitaffe yekka, si Mwana yekka, wabula abantu abasatu ab’omu Katonda Omu Ali mu Basatu. Kaakano, abantu bangi baagala akabonero akalala okuggyako ekigambo kya Katonda. Empisa eyo bulijjo ereeta okubuusabuusa. Bwe nnaasuubiza omusajja okumusisinkana ku ssaawa n’ekifo enkya, n’ansaba essaawa yange ng’akabonero ak’obwesimbu bwange, kyandivumye obwesigwa bwange. Tetusaana kubuusabuusa ekyo Katonda ky’agambye: yagamba ekigambo ku kigambo, n’ayaza olugero ku lugero. Kristo agamba nti: “Nze mulyango; omuntu yenna bw’ayingira ku bwange alirokolebwa.” “Nze Musumba Omulungi, era mmanyi endiga zange, era endiga zange zimmanyi.” “Nze musana gw’ensi; agoberera nze tajja kutambula mu kizikiza, wabula anaaba n’omusana ogw’obulamu.” “Nze mazima;” nnyaniriza nze, olyoke obeere n’amazima; kubanga nze kye kifaananyi ky’amazima. Oyagala okumanya ekkubo? “Nze kkubo:” ngoberera, nange nnaakutwala mu bwakabaka. Olumwa enjala olw’obutuukirivu? “Nze Mmere ey’obulamu:” bw’onoolya ku nze tolikwatibwa njala emirembe gyonna. “Nze Mazzi ag’obulamu:” bw’onoonywa ku mazzi gano ganaaba mu ggwe “oluzzi olw’amazzi olutiika okutuuka ku bulamu obutaggwaawo.” “Nze kuzuukira n’obulamu: akkiriza nze, ne bw’aba nga yafa, wabula aliba mulamu; era buli abeera omulamu era n’akkiriza nze talifa emirembe gyonna.” (Yokaana 11:25, 26.) Ka nkujjukize okubuusabuusa kwaffe gye kuva. Abantu ba Katonda abaagalwa bangi tebasukka kumanya nga bali baweereza bokka. Ye atuyita “mikwano.” Bw’oyingira mu nnyumba mangu olaba enjawulo wakati w’omuweereza n’omwana. Omwana atambula mu ddembe eddamba mu nnyumba yonna; ali eka. Naye omuweereza atwala ekifo eky’wansi. Kye twagala kwe kusukka okuba abaweereza. Tusaanidde okutegeera ekifo kyaffe eri Katonda ng’abaana ab’obulenzi n’ab’obuwala. Talyggya baana be obwana. Katonda tatuseleddemu kwokka, wabula tuli babe olw’okuzaalibwa: twazaalibwa mu bwakabaka bwe. Omwana wange omuto yali wange nga bw’ali kaakano ng’alina olunaku lumu nga bwe yazaalibwa nga kati alina emyaka kkumi n’ena. Yali mwana wange; newaakubadde nga tekyalabika kye yandifuuse bwe yandituuse ku bukulu. Wange; newaakubadde ng’ayinza okuyita mu kugezesebwa ng’ali wansi w’abasomesa n’abakuza. Abaana ba Katonda tebatuukiridde; naye tuli baana be ddala. Ensibuko endala ey’okubuusabuusa kwe kwetunuulira ffe bennyini. Bw’oyagala okuba omunakuwavu era omunyiikaavu, ng’ojjudde okubuusabuusa okuva ku makya okutuuka akawungeezi, weetunuulire. “Olimukuuma mu mirembe emituukiridde oyo omutima gwe gunywerera ku ggwe.” (Isaaya 26:3.) Abaana ba Katonda abaagalwa bangi banyagibwa essanyu kubanga beetunuulira bo bennyini. Waliwo eyagamba nti: “Waliwo engeri ssatu ez’okutunula. Bw’oyagala okuba omunakuwavu, tunula munda; bw’oyagala okweraliikirira, tunula ebikwetoolodde; naye bw’oyagala okuba n’emirembe, tunula waggulu.” Peetero yakyusa amaaso ge okuva ku Kristo, amangwago n’atandika okubbira. Mukama n’amugamba nti: “Ggwe ow’okukkiriza okutono! Kiki ekyakubuusizzabuusizza?” (Matayo 14:31.) Yalina ekigambo kya Katonda ekitaggwaawo, ekyali ekifo eky’okulinnyako ekinywevu, era ekisinga ejjinja, oba amayinja, oba ekyuma; naye bwe yaggya amaaso ge ku Kristo n’abbira. Abo abatunula ebibeetoolodde tebasobola kulaba nga engeri yaabwe ey’okutambula bw’eteesigika era bw’evvoola. Twagala okutunuulira butereevu “Omukuza n’Omutuukiriza ow’okukkiriza kwaffe.” Bwe nnali omulenzi, nnasobola okukola olugendo olugolokofu mu muzira nga simaze kutunula ku muti oba ku kintu ekirala ekiri mu maaso gange. Amangu nga bwe naggya eriiso lyange ku kintu ekyali mu maaso gange, natambula kyamagulu. Kiba bwe tutunula butereevu ku Kristo bwe tufuna emirembe emituukiridde. Bwe yamala okuzuukira mu bafu, yalaga abayigirizwa be emikono gye n’ebigere bye. (Lukka 24:40.) Ekyo kye kyali omusingi gw’emirembe gyabwe. Bw’oyagala okusaasaanya okubuusabuusa kwo, tunula ku musaayi; ne bw’oyagala okwongera okubuusabuusa kwo, weetunuulire. Onoofuna okubuusabuusa okumala emyaka bw’onoomala ennaku ntono nga weefaako ggwe bennyini. Ate: tunula ku ekyo ky’ali, ne ku ekyo ky’akoze; so si ku ekyo ky’oli, ne ku ekyo ky’okoze. Eyo y’engeri ey’okufuna emirembe n’okuwummula. Abraham Lincoln yalangirira okununulibwa kw’abaddu obukadde busatu. Ku lunaku olumu enjegere zaabwe zaali za kuggibwako, ne bafuuka ba ddembe. Ekiragiro kyawanikibwa ku miti n’oku bisenge buli awamu ekibinja ky’eggye ery’Obukiikakkono gye kyayita. Abaddu bangi tebaasobola kusoma: naye abalala baasoma ekiragiro, era abasinga obungi baakikkiriza; era ku lunaku olumu oluyoogaano olw’essanyu ne lulinnya nti, “Tuli ba ddembe!” Abamu tebaakikkiriza, ne basigala ne bakama baabwe ab’edda; naye ekyo tekyakyusa mazima nti baali ba ddembe. Kristo, Omukulembeze w’obulokozi bwaffe, alangirira eddembe eri bonna abamukkiririza. Ka tumukkirize ku kigambo kye. Enneewulira zaabwe teziyinza kufuula baddu ba ddembe. Amaanyi gateekwa okuva ebweru. Okwetunuulira ffe tekutufuula ba ddembe, wabula kwe kutunuulira Kristo n’eriiso ery’okukkiriza. Bishop Ryle yagamba mu ngeri ey’amaanyi nti: “Okukkiriza kwe kikolo, obukakafu kwe kimuli.” Kya lwatu toyinza kuba na kimuli awatali kikolo; naye kikakafu nti oyinza okuba n’ekikolo, naye n’obeera awatali kimuli. “Okukkiriza kwe mukazi oli omwavu eyakankana eyajja emabega wa Yesu mu kibiina, n’akwata ku lukugiro lw’ekyambalo kye. (Makko 5:27.) Obukakafu kwe Suteefaano ng’ayimiridde mirembe wakati mu batemu be, ng’agamba nti, ‘Ndaba eggulu nga libikkuse, n’Omwana w’Omuntu ng’ayimiridde ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda’” (Ebikolwa 7:56). “Okukkiriza kwe mubbi eyeenenya, ng’akaaba nti, ‘Mukama, onzijukire’ (Lukka 23:42). Obukakafu kwe Yobu ng’atudde mu nfuufu, ng’abikkiddwa amabwa, ng’agamba nti, ‘Nkimanyi nti Omununuzi wange mulamu;’ ‘Ne bw’anzita, naye nnaamwesiga’” (Yobu 19:25; 13:15). “Okukkiriza kwe kukaaba kwa Peetero ng’abbira, nga atandise okusaanawo, ‘Mukama, ndokole!’ (Matayo 14:30). Obukakafu kwe Peetero oyo omu ng’alangirira mu maaso g’Olukiiko, mu biseera ebyaddirira, nti, ‘Lino lye jjinja lye mwagaana mmwe abazimbi, lifuuse omutwe gw’oku nsonda: so tewali bulokozi mu mulala yenna; kubanga tewali linnya ddala wansi w’eggulu eryaweebwa mu bantu lye tuteekwa okulokolerwamu’” (Ebikolwa 4:11, 12). “Okukkiriza kwe ddoboozi ery’okweraliikirira, erikankana, ‘Mukama, nzikiriza; oyambe obutakkiriza bwange!’ (Makko 9:24). Obukakafu kwe kusoomoozebwa okw’obwesige, ‘Ani anaawawaabira abalonde ba Katonda? Ani anaasingisa omusango?’” (Abaruumi 8:33, 34). Okukkiriza kwe Sawulo ng’asaba mu nnyumba ya Yuda mu Damasiko, ng’anakuwadde, nga muzibe w’amaaso, era yekka. (Ebikolwa 9:11.) Obukakafu kwe Pawulo, omusibe omukadde, ng’atunula mirembe mu ntaana, ng’agamba nti, “Mmanyi gwe nzikirizza.” “Waliwo engule enterekeddwa nze” (2 Timoseewo 1:12; 4:8). “Okukkiriza bwe Bulamu. Omukisa nga munene! Ani ayinza okunnyonnyola enjawulo wakati w’obulamu n’okufa? Wabula obulamu buyinza okuba obunafu, obulwadde, obutali bulamu bulungi, obw’obulumi, obw’okukemebwa, obw’okweraliikirira, obukooye, obuzitowa, obutalimu ssanyu, obutalimu museke, okutuuka ku nkomerero. “Obukakafu bwe businga obulamu. Bwe bulamu obulungi, amaanyi, obuyinza, obunywevu, obunyiikivu, amaanyi, obusajja, obulungi.” Omusumba omu emu yasaba omukisa mu ngeri eno: “Omutima gwa Katonda gutwanirize; omusaayi gwa Kristo gutulongoose, era Omwoyo Omutukuvu atukakase.” Obukuume bw’omukkiriza buva ku mulimu gw’Omwoyo wa Katonda. Omuwandiisi omulala agamba nti: “Ndabye ebisaka n’emiti nga bimera nga biva mu mayinja, ne biwanikira ku bbanga ery’entiisa, ku bagga abavaayo n’oluyoogaano, ne ku mazzi amawanvu agakulukuta; naye byakuuma ekifo kyabyo, ne bifulumya amakoola n’amatabi nga bwe byandikoze singa byabadde wakati mu kibira ekikutte.” Kwali kunyweera kwabyo ku lwazi okwabikuuma; era enkola z’obutonde ze zaawanirira obulamu bwabyo. Bwe batyo abakkiriza emirundi mingi baba mu kabi ak’entiisa ennyo mu lugendo lwabwe olw’okugenda mu ggulu; naye, ng’ekiseera kyonna “basimbiddwa era baazimbibwa” ku Lwazi olw’Emirembe Gyonna, baba banywevu ddala. Okunyweera kwabwe ku ye kwe kwesigwa kwabwe; era emikisa egy’ekisa kye gibawa obulamu era gibawanirira mu bulamu. Era ng’omuti bwe guteekwa okufa, oba olwazi okugwa, nga tewannabaawo kwawukana wakati waabyo, bw’atyo omukkiriza ateekwa okufiirwa obulamu bwe obw’omwoyo, oba Olwazi kwe kusesebbuka, nga obumu bwabwe tebunnaayinza kwawukanyizibwa. Ng’ayogera ku Mukama waffe Yesu, Isaaya agamba nti: “Ndimusimba ng’omusumaali mu kifo ekinywevu; era aliba ntebe ya kitiibwa eri ennyumba ya Kitaawe: era balikanika ku ye ekitiibwa kyonna eky’ennyumba ya kitaawe, abaana n’abazzukulu, ebintu byonna ebitono, okuva ku bikopo, okutuuka ku nsuwa zonna” (22:23, 24). Waliwo omusumaali gumu, ogusimbiddwa mu kifo ekinywevu; era ku gwo we kwanikibwa ensuwa zonna n’ebikopo byonna. “Ayi,” bwe kigamba ekikopo ekitono, “ndi mutono nnyo era muddugavu nnyo, singa nnagwa!” “Ayi,” bw’egamba ensuwa, “tewali kutya ku ggwe; naye nze ndi muzito nnyo, muzito ddala, singa nnagwa!” N’ekikopo ekitono ne kigamba nti, “Ayi, singa mbadde nga ekikopo ekya zaabu ekiri wali, sandityanga kugwa.” Naye ekikopo ekya zaabu ne kiddamu nti, “Si lwa kubanga ndi kikopo kya zaabu kye nsigalira waggulu; wabula lwa kubanga nywerera ku musumaali.” Omusumaali bwe guteekulwa ffenna tugwa wansi, ebikopo bya zaabu, ebikopo eby’ebbumba, ebikopo eby’ekyuma, na byonna; naye ng’omusumaali gukyanyweredde waggulu, byonna ebiguliko biwanikira mirembe. Nsomye emu ku jjinja ery’oku ntaana ebigambo bino: “Yazaalibwa, yafa, yakuumibwa.” Ka tusabe Katonda atukuume mu mirembe emituukiridde, era nga tuli bakakafu ku bulokozi.

fields.title: Kristo ye Byonna era mu Byonna
fields.body_html:
(Abakkolosaayi iii. 11.)

Kristo abeera byonna gye tuli nga bwe tumufuula. Njagala okunyweza ekigambo ekyo “byonna.” Abantu abamu bamufuula “omulandira oguva mu ttaka ekkalu,” “atalina kifaananyi wadde obulungi.” Gy’oli tabaako kya makulu; tebamwagala. Abakristaayo abamu balina Omulokozi omutono nnyo, kubanga tebeetegese kumusembeza mu bujjuvu, ne bamuleka akole ebikulu era eby’amaanyi ku lwabwe. Abalala balina Omulokozi ow’amaanyi, kubanga bamufuula omukulu era ow’amaanyi.

Bwe tuba twagala okumanya Kristo ky’ayagala okuba gye tuli, tusooka kumumanya ng’Omulokozi waffe eyatulokola mu kibi. Malayika bwe yava mu ggulu okulangirira nti anaazaalibwa mu nsi, mujjukira nga yamuwa erinnya, “Anaayitibwanga Yesu, kubanga y’anaalokolanga abantu be okuva mu bibi byabwe.” Ffe twalokolebwa mu kibi? Teyajja kutulokola nga tuli mu bibi byaffe, wabula okutulokola okuva mu bibi byaffe. Kaakano waliwo engeri ssatu ez’okumanya omuntu. Abamu obamanya buli lw’owulira; abalala obamanya lwa kubanga wali oyanjuliddwa gye bali omulundi gumu, obamanyako katono nnyo; ate abalala obamanya kubanga obadde nabo emyaka mingi, obamanyira ddala. Bwe ntyo nzikiriza nti waliwo ebibinja bisatu eby’abantu leero mu Kkanisa ya Kristo ne ebweru waayo: abo abamanyi Kristo lwa kusoma oba lwa kuwulira, abalina Kristo ow’ebyafaayo; abo abalina okumumanyako okutono; n’abo abalumwa ennyonta, nga Paulo bwe yali, “okumumanya n’amaanyi ag’okuzuukira kwe.” Gye tweyongera okumanya Kristo, gye tuneeyongera okumwagala, era gye tunaamuweerezeza obulungi.

Ka tumutunuulire ng’awanikiddwa ku Musaalaba, tulabe nga bw’aggyewo ekibi. Yalabisibwa alyoke aggyewo ebibi byaffe; era bwe tuba tumumanyidde ddala, tusaanidde okusooka okumulaba ng’Omulokozi waffe eyatulokola mu kibi. Mujjukira bamalayika nga bwe baagamba abasumba mu ttale ery’e Besirekemu nti, “Laba, mbaleetera amawulire amalungi ag’essanyu lingi, aganaabeeranga eri abantu bonna: kubanga leero muzaaliddwa, mu kibuga kya Dawudi, Omulokozi, ye Kristo Mukama.” (Luuka ii. 10, 11.) Ate bw’oddayo dda eri Isaaya, emyaka lusanvu Kristo nga tannazaalibwa, ojja kusanga ebigambo bino: “Nze, weewaawo Nze, nze Mukama; era awatali Nze tewali mulokozi” (xliii. 11).

Ate mu Ebbaluwa eyasooka eya Yokaana (iv. 14) tusoma nti: “Twalaba, era tutegeeza, nti Kitaffe yatuma Omwana okuba Omulokozi w’ensi.” Amadiini gonna ag’abakaafiiri, nga bwe tusoma, gayigiriza abantu okwewulira okwolinnya eri Katonda; naye eddiini ya Yesu Kristo ye Katonda akkirira abantu okubalokola, okubaggya mu bunnya bw’ekibi. Mu Luuka xix. 10, tusoma nti Kristo yennyini yagamba abantu ekyo kye yajjira: “Omwana w’omuntu yajja okunoonya n’okulokola ekyo ekyabula.” Kale tutandikira ku Musaalaba, so si ku kitanda ky’omwana omuto. Kristo yatuggulirawo ekkubo eppya era eddamu erituusa eri Kitaffe; yaggyawo enkonge zonna mu kkubo, buli muntu asembeza Kristo ng’Omulokozi we alyoke afune obulokozi.

Naye Kristo si Mulokozi kyokka. Nnyinza okulokola omuntu obutasaanawo mu mazzi ne mmuwonya obutafiira mu ntaana ku budde obutannatuuka; naye oboolyawo sijja kuyinza kumukolera kirala. Kristo ye kisingako ku Mulokozi. Abaana ba Isiraeri bwe baateekebwa emabega w’omusaayi, omusaayi ogwo gwe gwali obulokozi bwabwe; naye bandigumiridde okuwulira okuvuga kw’embooko y’omusiba w’abaddu singa tebaawonyezebwa mu kikoligo ky’obuddu bw’e Misiri: mu kiseera ekyo Katonda kwe yabawonyeza mu mukono gwa kabaka w’e Misiri. Sirina kusaasira kwa ndowooza egamba nti Katonda akkirira okutulokola, ne alyoka atuleka mu kkomera, nga tuli baddu b’ebibi ebitunywezaako. Nedda; yajja okutuwonya, n’okutuwa obuwanguzi ku busungu bwaffe obubi, ku kwegomba kwaffe, ne ku bukaba bwaffe. Oli Mukristaayo eyeeyita bw’atyo naye nga muddu w’ekibi ekimunywezaako? Bw’oba oyagala okufuna obuwanguzi ku busungu obwo oba okwegomba okwo, weeyongere okumanya Kristo n’okumusemberera. Aleeta obulokozi obw’ebyayita, obw’olwa leero, n’obw’ebijja. “Eyatuwonya; era awonya; era anaatuwonya.” (2 Abakkoolinso i. 10.)

Emirundi emeka, ng’abaana ba Isiraeri bwe baatuuka ku Nnyanja Emyufu, gye twaggwaamu amaanyi kubanga buli kimu kyalabika nga kizikiza mu maaso gaffe, emabega waffe, ne wonna okutwetooloola, nga tetumanyi kkubo lya kukwata. Nga Peetero bwe twagamba nti, “Tunaagenda eri ani?” Naye Katonda yajja olw’okutuwonya. Yatuyisa mu Nnyanja Emyufu n’atutuusa mu ddungu, n’aggulawo ekkubo okutuusa mu Nsi Eyasuubizibwa. Naye Kristo si Muwonyi waffe yekka; ye Munnunuzi waffe. Kino kisingako ku kuba Omulokozi waffe. Yatukomyawo. “Mwetunda bwereere; era mulinunulibwa awatali nsimbi.” (Isaaya lii. 3.) “Tetwanunulibwa na bintu ebivunda, ng’effeeza ne zaabu.” (1 Peetero i. 18.) Singa zaabu yandituzze okutununula, tandiyinzizza kutonda nsi omutwalo ogujjudde zaabu?

Katonda bwe yamala okununula abaana ba Isiraeri okuva mu buddu bw’e Misiri, n’abayisa mu Nnyanja Emyufu, ne balaga mu ddungu; awo Katonda n’abeera gye bali Ekkubo lyabwe. Nsiima nnyo kubanga Mukama tatulese mu kizikiza ku lw’ekkubo ettuufu. Tewali muntu mulamu abadde awammanga mu kizikiza atayinza kumanya kkubo. “Nze kkubo,” bw’ayogera Kristo. Bwe tugoberera Kristo tunaabeera mu kkubo ettuufu, era tunaabeera n’enjigiriza entuufu. Ani ayinza okukulembera abaana ba Isiraeri mu ddungu nga Katonda Ayinzabyonna yennyini? Yamanya ebinnya n’akabi ak’omu kkubo, n’akulembera abantu mu lugendo lwabwe lwonna olw’omu ddungu okubatuusa mu nsi eyasuubizibwa. Kya mazima nti singa si lwa butakkiriza bwabwe obukolimire, bandisomose ne bayingira mu nsi e Kadesi Baluneya, ne bagitwala, naye baayagala ekintu ekirala okwawukana ku kigambo kya Katonda; bwe batyo ne bazzibwa emabega, ne kibagwanira okutambulatambula mu ddungu okumala emyaka amakumi ana. Nzikiriza nti waliwo enkumi n’enkumi ez’abaana ba Katonda abakyatambulatambula mu ddungu ne kaakano. Mukama abawonyezza mu mukono gw’Omumisiri, era yandibayisizza mu ddungu amangwago n’abatuusa mu Nsi Eyasuubizibwa, singa baali beetegefu kugoberera Kristo. Kristo yajja wano wansi, n’agolola ebifo ebizibu, n’amulisa ebifo eby’ekizikiza, n’agolola ebifo ebikyamu. Bwe tunaaganya okukulemberwa Ye, ne tumugoberera, byonna binaabeera mirembe, na ssanyu, na kuwummula.

Mu bitundu eby’oku nsalo, omuntu bw’agenda okuyigga atwala embazzi, n’asalako ebitundu ku bikuta by’emiti ng’ayita mu kibira: kino kiyitibwa “okuteekawo obubonero bw’ekkubo.” Akikola alyoke amanye ekkubo ery’okudda, kubanga tewali luguudo mu bibira ebyo ebikutte. Kristo yajja wano ku nsi; “yateekawo obubonero bw’Ekkubo:” era kaakano nga alinnye waggulu, bwe tunaamugoberera, tunaakuumibwa mu kkubo ettuufu. Nnaakubuulira engeri gy’oyinza okumanyamu oba ogoberera Kristo oba nedda. Singa omuntu akuwaayirizza, oba akusaliddeko omusango mu bukyamu, obayisa nga mukama wo bwe yandikoze? Bw’oba togumira bino n’omwoyo ogw’okwagala n’okusonyiwa, kkanisa zonna n’abaweereza bonna ab’omu nsi tebayinza kukutereeza. “Omuntu yenna bw’ataba na Mwoyo wa Kristo, oyo si wuwe.” (Abaruumi viii. 9.) “Omuntu yenna bw’aba mu Kristo Yesu, aba kitonde kiggya: eby’edda biweddewo; laba, byonna bifuuse biggya.” (2 Abakkoolinso v. 17.)

Kristo si kkubo lyaffe lyokka; ye Ekitangaala ku kkubo. Agamba nti, “Nze Kitangaala ky’ensi.” (Yokaana viii. 12; ix. 5; xii. 46.) Ayongera n’agamba nti, “Angoberera taatambulire mu kizikiza, naye anaabanga n’ekitangaala eky’obulamu.” Tekisoboka omusajja oba omukazi yenna agoberera Kristo okutambulira mu kizikiza. Emmeeme yo bw’eba mu kizikiza, ng’ewammanga mu lufu n’olubinja lw’ensi, ka nkubuulire nti kiba lwa kubanga oveewo ku kitangaala ekituufu. Tewali kirala wabula ekitangaala ekiggyawo ekizikiza. Kale abo abatambulira mu kizikiza eky’omwoyo ka basembeze Kristo mu mitima gyabwe: Ye Kitangaala. Nzijukira ekifaananyi kye nnali nfaako ennyo edda; naye kaakano bwe ndabye n’obwegendereza, sandikiwanise mu nnyumba yange okuggyako nga nkyusizza amaaso gaakyo okwolekera ekisenge. Kirangirira Kristo ng’ayimiridde ku luggi, ng’akonkona, ng’akutte ettaala ennene mu mukono gwe. Naye kiba kifaanana ng’owanise ettaala eri enjuba nga bw’owadde emu mu mukono gwa Kristo. Ye Njuba ey’obutuukirivu; era kya mukisa gye tuli okutambulira mu kitangaala ky’enjuba etaliiko bire.

Abantu bangi banoonya ekitangaala, n’emirembe, n’essanyu. Tetulagirwa wamu okunoonya ebintu bino. Bwe tusembeza Kristo mu mitima gyaffe, bino byonna binajja byokka. Nzijukira, nga ndi mulenzi, nga ngezaako obutayinza okukwata ekisiikirize kyange. Olunaku lumu nnali ntambula nga nnyolese amaaso gange eri enjuba; ne bwe nnatunula okwetooloola ne ndaba ekisiikirize kyange nga kingoberera. Gye nnasingira okwanguya, gye kyasingira ekisiikirize kyange okungoberera; saayinza kukivaako. Bwe kityo amaaso gaffe bwe gaba geeyolekedde Enjuba ey’obutuukirivu, emirembe n’essanyu binajja awatali kubuusabuusa. Omusajja yaŋŋamba edda nti, “Moody, owulira otya?” Kyali kimaze ebbanga eddene nga sirowoozeeko ku nneewulira yange, ne kimba kya kuyimirira ne nfumiitiriza akaseera, ndyoke ntegeere. Abakristaayo abamu bulijjo balowooza ku nneewulira yaabwe; era kubanga tebeewulira bulungi, balowooza nti essanyu lyabwe liweddewo. Bwe tunaakuuma amaaso gaffe nga geeyolekedde Kristo, ne tumwefaako, tunaggibwa mu kizikiza ne mu buzibu obuyinza okuba nga bukuŋŋaanidde okwetooloola ekkubo lyaffe.

Nzijukira nga ndi mu lukuŋŋaana oluvannyuma lw’olutalo olw’obujeemu obunene lwe lwatandika. Olutalo lwali lumaze ng’emyezi mukaaga. Eggye ery’Obukiikakkono lyali liwanguddwa e Bull Run, ddala twali tetulina kya kunyweza wabula okuwangulwa, era kyalabika ng’eggwanga ligenda kusaanawo. Bwe tutyo twali tuweddemu amaanyi nnyo ne tuggwaamu essuubi. Mu lukuŋŋaana luno buli eyayogera okumala akaseera yali afaanana ng’awanise ennanga ye ku muti; era lwali lumu ku nkuŋŋaana ennakuwavu ennyo ze nnali nnaakubaddeko. Ku nkomerero omukadde ow’enviiri enjeru ennungi n’ayimirira okwogera, era amaaso ge ne gamasamasa ddala. “Abavubuka,” bwe yagamba “temwogera ng’abaana ba Kabaka. Newankubadde nga wano kizikiza, mujjukire nti walala waliwo ekitangaala.” N’ayongerayo okugamba nti singa kyandibadde kizikiza mu nsi yonna, waggulu okwetooloola Entebe ey’Obwakabaka kwali kitangaala.

Yatugamba nti yali avudde ebuvanjuba, mukwano gwe gy’eyamunnyonnyola engeri gye yali alinnye olusozi okusula ekiro n’okulaba enjuba ng’evaayo. Ekibiina nga kirinnya olusozi, era nga tebannatuuka ku ntikko, omuyaga ne gutandika. Mukwano gwe ono n’agamba omukulembeze nti, “Nnaakivaako; nzizaayo.” Omukulembeze n’amwenyamwenya, n’addamu nti, “Ndowooza tunaatera okuyita waggulu w’omuyaga.” Ne beeyongera; era tekyamala bbanga ne batuuka waggulu ng’ali mu ttebenkevu ng’akawungeezi konna ak’ekyeya. Wansi mu kiwonvu omuyaga ogw’entiisa gwali gukunta; baali bawulira okubwatuka kw’eggulu, n’okulaba okumyansa kw’eraddu; naye byonna byali biteredde ku ntikko y’olusozi. “Bwe kityo, mikwano gyange abato,” omukadde n’ayongera, “newankubadde nga byonna bizikiza okukwetooloola, sembera waggulu katono, ekizikiza kinaddukanga.” Emirundi mingi bwe mba nga ntera okuggwaamu essuubi, ndowooza ku ekyo kye yayogera. Kale bw’oba oli wansi mu kiwonvu wakati mu lufu olukutte n’ekizikiza, sembera waggulu katono; sembera okumpi ne Kristo, era weeyongere okumumanya.

Mujjukira Bayibuli nga bw’egamba, nti Kristo bwe yassa omukka ku musaalaba, ekitangaala ky’ensi kyazikizibwa. Katonda yatuma Omwana we okuba ekitangaala ky’ensi; naye abantu tebaayagala kitangaala kubanga kyabanenya ebibi byabwe. Bwe baali bagenda okuzikiza ekitangaala kino, Kristo yagamba ki abayigirizwa be? “Munaabeeranga bajulirwa bange.” (Ebikolwa i. 8.) Alinnye eri waggulu okutwegayiririra; naye ayagala ffe okumwakira wano wansi. “Mmwe muli kitangaala ky’ensi.” (Matayo v. 14.) Kale omulimu gwaffe kwe kwaka; si kufuuwa ekkondeere lyaffe ffennyini abantu balyoke batutunuulire. Kye twagala okukola kwe kulaga Kristo. Bwe tuba n’ekitangaala kyonna, kiba kitangaala kya kwewola. Omuntu yagamba Omukristaayo omuvubuka nti: “Okukyusibwa! ekyo kyonna bulimba bwa mwezi!” N’agamba nti: “Nkwebaza olw’ekifaananyi; omwezi gwewola ekitangaala kyagwo okuva mu njuba; nga naffe bwe tweewola ekyaffe okuva mu Njuba ey’obutuukirivu.” Bwe tuba aba Kristo, tuli wano okumwakira: mu bbanga atunaayita eka eri empeera yaffe.

Nzijukira okuwulira eby’omuntu omuzibe w’amaaso eyali atudde ku mabbali g’ekkubo nga alina ettaala okumpi naye. Bwe yabuuzibwa ettaala gye yali agirinira, kubanga yali tasobola kulaba kitangaala, yagamba nti kyali kiri abantu baleme okumwesittalako. Nzikiriza nti abantu abasinga obungi beesittala ku mpisa ezitakwatagana ez’abo abeeyita Bakristaayo okusinga ensonga endala yonna. Ekisinga okwonoona omulimu gwa Kristo okusinga okubuusabuusa kwonna okw’omu nsi, ye ntambula eno enjolo, enfu, ey’empisa ez’okulabika kwokka, okufaanana kw’ensi, okwatula ekyo kye tulina so si. Amaaso g’ensi gatutunuulidde. Ndowooza yali George Fox eyagamba nti buli Omukwaka asaanidde okumulisa ensi okumala mayiro kkumi ezimwetoolodde. Singa fenna twali twaka bulungi ku lwa Mukama waffe, abo abatwetoolodde bandyanguwuddwa okutuukirira, era wandibaddewo oluyoogaano lw’okutendereza olwambuka mu ggulu.

Abantu bagamba nti: “Njagala okumanya amazima kye ki.” Wuliriza: “Nze mazima,” bw’ayogera Kristo. (Yokaana xiv. 5.) Bw’oba oyagala okumanya amazima kye ki, manyiira Kristo. Abantu era beemulugunya nti tebalina bulamu. Bangi bagezaako okwewa obulamu obw’omwoyo. Muyinza okweleetera amaanyi n’okwessaamu amasannyalaze, ka twogere bwe tutyo; naye ekivaamu tekiimale bbanga ddene. Kristo yekka y’atonda obulamu. Bw’oba oyagala okuba n’obulamu obw’omwoyo obw’amazima, manyiira Kristo. Bangi bagezaako okuzuukusa obulamu obw’omwoyo nga bagenda mu nkuŋŋaana. Ekyo kiyinza okuba nga kirungi; naye tekiigase, okuggyako nga batuukirira Kristo omulamu. Olwo obulamu bwabwe obw’omwoyo tebuubeere kya kabenje, wabula bunaabeera bwa lubeerera; nga bukulukuta ne bweyongerayo, ne bubala ebibala eri Katonda.

Ate Kristo ye Mukuumi waffe. Abayigirizwa abato bangi nnyo batya nti tebaligumira. “Akuuma Isiraeri taabongoote wadde okwebaka.” (Zabbuli cxxi. 4.) Guli mulimu gwa Kristo okutukuuma; era bw’atukuuma tewaabeere kabi ka kugwa. Ndowooza singa Kabaka Vikitoliya yali alina okulabirira Engule y’e Bungereza, omubbi yandigezezzaako okugituukako; naye eterekeddwa mu Kigo ky’e London, era ekuumibwa emisana n’ekiro abaserikale. Eggye ly’e Bungereza lyonna, singa kyetaagisa, lyandiyitiddwa okugikuuma. Naffe tetulina maanyi mu ffe fennyini. Tetwenkanankana na Setaani; alina obumanyirivu obw’emyaka kakaaga. Naye ate tujjukira nti Oyo atabongoota wadde okwebaka ye Mukuumi waffe. Mu Isaaya xli. 10, tusoma nti, “Totya, kubanga ndi naawe; totekemuka, kubanga ndi Katonda wo; nnaakunywezanga; weewaawo nnaakuyambanga; weewaawo nnaakuwaniririranga n’omukono gwange ogwa ddyo ogw’obutuukirivu bwange.” Ne mu Yuda kyokka, olunyiriri 24, tubuulirwa nti “asobola okutukuuma tuleme okugwa.” “Tulina Omuwolereza eri Kitaffe, Yesu Kristo omutuukirivu.” (1 Yokaana ii. 1.)

Naye Kristo ye kisingako. Ye Musumba waffe. Guli mulimu gw’omusumba okulabirira endiga, okuziriisa n’okuzikuuma. “Nze Musumba Omulungi;” “Endiga zange ziwulira eddoboozi lyange.” “Nteekawo obulamu bwange ku lw’endiga.” Mu ssuula eyo ey’ekkumi eya Yokaana ey’ekitalo, Kristo akozesa akabonero ak’omuntu emirundi egitasingako amakumi abiri mu munaana, ng’alangirira ky’ali n’ekyo ky’anaakola. Mu lunyiriri 28 agamba nti, “Tezirizikirira n’akamu; so tewali n’omu [muntu] alizisikula mu mukono gwange.” Naye laba nga ekigambo “muntu” kiri mu nnukuta ezisulise. Laba engeri olunyiriri gye lusomebwa ddala: “So tewali n’omu alizisikula mu mukono gwange”—tewali sitaani wadde muntu aliyinza kukikola. Mu kifo ekirala Ekyawandiikibwa kirangirira nti, “Obulamu bwo bukwekeddwa awamu ne Kristo mu Katonda.” (Abakkolosaayi iii. 3.) Nga tuli mirembe era nga tukuumiddwa!

Kristo agamba nti, “Endiga zange ziwulira eddoboozi lyange . . . era zingoberera.” (Yokaana x. 27.) Omusajja omu mu buvanjuba yawulira eby’omusumba eyali asobola okuyita endiga ze zonna ku mannya gaazo. N’agenda n’abuuza oba kino kyali kya mazima. Omusumba n’amutwala mu ddundiro endiga gye zaali, n’ayita emu ku zo ku linnya erimu. Endiga emu n’eyimusa amaaso n’eyitaba okuyitibwa, ate endala nga zeeyongera okulya nga tezifaayo. Mu ngeri y’emu n’ayita ng’endiga kkumi na bbiri ne zimwetooloola. Omugenyi n’agamba nti, “Omanya otya emu okuva ku ndala? Zonna zifaanana bumu ddala.” “Kale,” n’agamba, “olaba endiga eri erina engalo eziwundamye katono; eyo endala erina okukukunala; emu eggyibbwako akatundu k’ebyoya; endala erina akabaala akaddugavu; ate endala erina akatundu akaggibbwako ku kutu kwayo.” Omusajja yamanya endiga ze zonna olw’obulema bwazo, kubanga yali talina ndiga ntuukirivu mu kisibo kyonna. Ndowooza Omusumba waffe atumanya mu ngeri y’emu.

Omusumba omu ow’omu buvanjuba yali agamba omusajja nti endiga ze zaamanya eddoboozi lye, era nga tewali mugenyi ayinza kuzirimba. Omusajja n’alowooza nti yandyagadde okugezesa ekigambo ekyo. Bw’atyo n’ayambala ekkanzu y’omusumba n’ekiremba, n’atwala omuggo gwe n’agenda eri ekisibo. N’akyusa eddoboozi lye, n’agezaako okwogera nga bw’asobola okufaanana omusumba; naye teyasobola kufuna ndiga n’emu mu kisibo kugimugoberera. N’abuuza omusumba oba endiga ze tezaali zigoberera mugenyi. N’akakibwa okukkiriza nti singa endiga erwala yandigobereredde omuntu yenna. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n’Abakristaayo bangi abeeyita bwe batyo; bwe balwala ne banafuwa mu kukkiriza, banaagoberera omuyigiriza yenna ajja; naye emmeeme bw’eba nga nnamu, omuntu taatwalibwe nsobi na njigiriza za bulimba. Anaamanya oba “eddoboozi” lyogera mazima oba nedda. Anaakitegeera mangu, bw’aba nga ddala ali mu kussa kimu ne Katonda. Katonda bw’atuma omubaka ow’amazima, ebigambo bye binaasangibwa nga byanirizibwa mu mutima gw’Omukristaayo.

Kristo Musumba wa kisa. Oyinza olumu okulowooza nti tabadde Musumba wa kisa nnyo gy’oli; oli wansi w’oluga. Kyawandiikibwa nti, “Mukama gw’ayagala amukangavvula, era akuba buli mwana gw’akkiriza.” (Abaebbulaniya xii. 6.) Okuba nti oli wansi w’oluga si bujulizi nti Kristo takwagala. Mukwano gwange omu yafiirwa abaana be bonna. Tewali muntu yandyagadde nnyumba ye okusinga; naye omusujja ogumyufu ne guggyawo omu ku omu; bwe batyo bonna abana oba abataano, omu ku omu, ne bafa. Bakadde abaakosebwa ennaku ne bagenda e Bungereza, ne batambulatambula okuva mu kifo ekimu okudda mu kirala, eyo ne ku ssemazinga. Oluvannyuma ne batuuka mu Siriya. Olunaku lumu ne balaba omusumba ow’omu buvanjuba ng’aserengeta ku mugga, ng’ayita ekisibo kye okusomoka. Endiga ne zisemberera ku lubalama, ne zitunuulira amazzi; naye ne zooleka nga zitya okugayingira, n’atasobola kuzifuula kwanukula kuyita kwe. N’alyoka addira omwana gw’endiga omuto, n’aguteeka wansi w’okumba kumu; n’addira omwana gw’endiga omulala n’aguteeka wansi w’okumba okulala, bw’atyo n’ayingira mu mugga. Endiga enkulu ne zireka okuyimirira nga zitunuulira amazzi: ne zeesuula mu mazzi nga zigoberera omusumba; era mu ddakiika ntono ekisibo kyonna ne kituuka ku ludda olulala; n’azitwala eri amalundiro amaggya era amabisi. Taata ne maama abaafiirwa, nga batunuulira ebibaddewo, ne bawulira nti kyabayigiriza ekintu. Ne balekayo okwemulugunya kubanga Omusumba Omukulu yali atutte abaana baabwe ab’endiga omu ku omu okubatwala mu nsi eri; ne batandika okutunula waggulu n’okusuubira ekiseera lwe balibagoberera abaagalwa be baali baafiirwa. Bw’oba olina abaagalwa abaakukulembera, jjukira nti Omusumba wo akuyita “otekenga omwoyo gwo ku bintu ebiri waggulu.” (Abakkolosaayi iii. 2.) Ka tumubeere beesigwa, ne tumugoberera, nga tukyali mu nsi eno. Era bw’oba tonnamutwala kuba Musumba wo, kikole ku lunaku luno lwennyini.

Kristo si bino byonna byokka bye njogeddeko: era ye Mutabaganya waffe, Omutukuza waffe, Atuwa obutuukirivu; ddala, kyandyetaagisa ebitabo bingi okwogera ky’ayagala okuba eri buli mmeeme yonna. Nga nnyalula empapula ezimu, edda nnasoma okunnyonnyola kuno okw’ekitalo okukwata ku Kristo. Simanyi we kwava okusooka; naye kwali kupya bwe kutyo eri emmeeme yange nga nandyagadde okukubawa:—

“Kristo ye Kkubo lyaffe; tutambulira mu Ye. Ye Mazima gaffe; tumugwira. Ye Bulamu bwaffe; tuli balamu mu Ye. Ye Mukama waffe; tumulonda okutufuga. Ye Mukama waffe omukulu; tumuweereza. Ye Muyigiriza waffe, atuyigiriza mu kkubo ery’obulokozi. Ye Nnabbi waffe, alaga ebijja. Ye Kabona waffe, eyatutangiririra. Ye Muwolereza waffe, abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okutwegayiririra. Ye Mulokozi waffe, alokola okutuusa ku nkomerero. Ye Mulandira gwaffe; tukula okuva mu Ye. Ye Mmere yaffe; tumulyako. Ye Musumba waffe, atukulembera mu malundiro amalamu. Ye Muzabbibu gwaffe ogw’amazima; tubeera mu Ye. Ye Mazzi ag’Obulamu; tumalawo ennyonta yaffe okuva mu Ye. Ye asinga obulungi mu omutwalo: tumwagala okusinga abalala bonna. Ye ‘okumasamasa kw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe, era ekifaananyi kye ekituufu eky’obuntu bwe;’ tufuba okwoleka ekifaananyi kye. Ye awanirira ebintu byonna; tuwummulira ku Ye. Ye magezi gaffe; atuluŋŋamya. Ye Butuukirivu bwaffe; tusuula obutali butuukirivu bwaffe bwonna ku Ye. Ye Kutukuzibwa kwaffe; tunaga amaanyi gaffe gonna ag’obulamu obutukuvu okuva mu Ye. Ye Kununulibwa kwaffe, atununula okuva mu butali butuukirivu bwonna. Ye Muwonya waffe, awonya endwadde zaffe zonna. Ye Mukwano gwaffe, atuyamba mu byetaago byaffe byonna. Ye Mooluganda waffe, atusanyusa mu buzibu bwaffe.”

Kuno kwe kunnyonnyola okulala okulungi: kuva eri Gotthold:

“Ku lwange, emmeeme yange eri ng’omwana alumwa enjala n’ennyonta; era neetaaga okwagala kwe n’okubudaabudibwa kwe okummusaamusa. Ndi ndiga ebulubuuta era ebuze; era mmwetaaga ng’omusumba omulungi era omwesigwa. Emmeeme yange eri ng’ejjiba eritidde nga likomberezebwa akamunye; era neetaaga ebiwundu bye okuba obuddukiro. Ndi muzabbibu munafu; era neetaaga omusaalaba gwe okugukwatako, n’okwezingako. Ndi mwonoonyi; era neetaaga obutuukirivu bwe. Ndi bwereere era ndi mwereere; era neetaaga obutukuvu bwe n’obutaliiko musango okuba ekibikka. Simanyi; era neetaaga okuyigiriza kwe: ndi mwangu era musirusiru; era neetaaga okuluŋŋamizibwa kw’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu. Mu mbeera yonna, era mu kiseera kyonna, siyinza kubaawo awatali Ye. Nsaba? Ye ateekwa okunkubiriza, n’okunneegayiririra. Mpawaabirwa Setaani mu mbuga ya Katonda? Ye ateekwa okuba Omuwolereza wange. Ndi mu kubonaabona? Ye ateekwa okuba Omuyambi wange. Njigganyizibwa ensi? Ye ateekwa okunnwanirira. Bwe nvaabulwa, Ye ateekwa okuba Omuwanirizi wange; bwe mba nfa, obulamu bwange: bwe mba nvunda mu ntaana, Okuzuukira kwange. Kale, nnaasinga okwawukana n’ensi yonna, ne byonna bye erimu, okusinga okwawukana naawe, Omulokozi wange. Era, Katonda yeebazibwe! Mmanyi nti naawe, toyinza wadde toyagala kubaawo awatali nze. Oli mugagga; nga nze ndi mwavu. Olina obungi; nga nze ndi mwetaavu. Olina obutuukirivu; nga nze ebibi. Olina omwenge n’amafuta; nga nze ebiwundu. Olina ebiwooma n’ebisaamusa; nga nze enjala n’ennyonta.

Kale nkozese, Omulokozi wange, mu buli kigendererwa, era mu buli ngeri, gy’oyinza okwetaaga. Guno gwe mutima gwange omwavu, ekibya ekyereere; kijjuze ekisa kyo. Eno y’emmeeme yange ey’ekibi era eteganyizibbwa; gizuukuse ogisaamuse n’okwagala kwo. Twala omutima gwange gube ky’obeeramu; akamwa kange okusaasaanya ekitiibwa ky’erinnya lyo; okwagala kwange n’amaanyi gange gonna, olw’okukulaakulanya abantu bo abakkiriza; era toganya bunywevu n’obwesige bw’okukkiriza kwange kukendeera—olwo mu biseera byonna nsobozesebwe okwogera okuva ku mutima nti. ‘Yesu anneetaaga, era nange mmwetaaga; bwe tutyo tuba tusaanyi omu ku omu.’”
fields.body_text: (Abakkolosaayi iii. 11.) Kristo abeera byonna gye tuli nga bwe tumufuula. Njagala okunyweza ekigambo ekyo “byonna.” Abantu abamu bamufuula “omulandira oguva mu ttaka ekkalu,” “atalina kifaananyi wadde obulungi.” Gy’oli tabaako kya makulu; tebamwagala. Abakristaayo abamu balina Omulokozi omutono nnyo, kubanga tebeetegese kumusembeza mu bujjuvu, ne bamuleka akole ebikulu era eby’amaanyi ku lwabwe. Abalala balina Omulokozi ow’amaanyi, kubanga bamufuula omukulu era ow’amaanyi. Bwe tuba twagala okumanya Kristo ky’ayagala okuba gye tuli, tusooka kumumanya ng’Omulokozi waffe eyatulokola mu kibi. Malayika bwe yava mu ggulu okulangirira nti anaazaalibwa mu nsi, mujjukira nga yamuwa erinnya, “Anaayitibwanga Yesu, kubanga y’anaalokolanga abantu be okuva mu bibi byabwe.” Ffe twalokolebwa mu kibi? Teyajja kutulokola nga tuli mu bibi byaffe, wabula okutulokola okuva mu bibi byaffe. Kaakano waliwo engeri ssatu ez’okumanya omuntu. Abamu obamanya buli lw’owulira; abalala obamanya lwa kubanga wali oyanjuliddwa gye bali omulundi gumu, obamanyako katono nnyo; ate abalala obamanya kubanga obadde nabo emyaka mingi, obamanyira ddala. Bwe ntyo nzikiriza nti waliwo ebibinja bisatu eby’abantu leero mu Kkanisa ya Kristo ne ebweru waayo: abo abamanyi Kristo lwa kusoma oba lwa kuwulira, abalina Kristo ow’ebyafaayo; abo abalina okumumanyako okutono; n’abo abalumwa ennyonta, nga Paulo bwe yali, “okumumanya n’amaanyi ag’okuzuukira kwe.” Gye tweyongera okumanya Kristo, gye tuneeyongera okumwagala, era gye tunaamuweerezeza obulungi. Ka tumutunuulire ng’awanikiddwa ku Musaalaba, tulabe nga bw’aggyewo ekibi. Yalabisibwa alyoke aggyewo ebibi byaffe; era bwe tuba tumumanyidde ddala, tusaanidde okusooka okumulaba ng’Omulokozi waffe eyatulokola mu kibi. Mujjukira bamalayika nga bwe baagamba abasumba mu ttale ery’e Besirekemu nti, “Laba, mbaleetera amawulire amalungi ag’essanyu lingi, aganaabeeranga eri abantu bonna: kubanga leero muzaaliddwa, mu kibuga kya Dawudi, Omulokozi, ye Kristo Mukama.” (Luuka ii. 10, 11.) Ate bw’oddayo dda eri Isaaya, emyaka lusanvu Kristo nga tannazaalibwa, ojja kusanga ebigambo bino: “Nze, weewaawo Nze, nze Mukama; era awatali Nze tewali mulokozi” (xliii. 11). Ate mu Ebbaluwa eyasooka eya Yokaana (iv. 14) tusoma nti: “Twalaba, era tutegeeza, nti Kitaffe yatuma Omwana okuba Omulokozi w’ensi.” Amadiini gonna ag’abakaafiiri, nga bwe tusoma, gayigiriza abantu okwewulira okwolinnya eri Katonda; naye eddiini ya Yesu Kristo ye Katonda akkirira abantu okubalokola, okubaggya mu bunnya bw’ekibi. Mu Luuka xix. 10, tusoma nti Kristo yennyini yagamba abantu ekyo kye yajjira: “Omwana w’omuntu yajja okunoonya n’okulokola ekyo ekyabula.” Kale tutandikira ku Musaalaba, so si ku kitanda ky’omwana omuto. Kristo yatuggulirawo ekkubo eppya era eddamu erituusa eri Kitaffe; yaggyawo enkonge zonna mu kkubo, buli muntu asembeza Kristo ng’Omulokozi we alyoke afune obulokozi. Naye Kristo si Mulokozi kyokka. Nnyinza okulokola omuntu obutasaanawo mu mazzi ne mmuwonya obutafiira mu ntaana ku budde obutannatuuka; naye oboolyawo sijja kuyinza kumukolera kirala. Kristo ye kisingako ku Mulokozi. Abaana ba Isiraeri bwe baateekebwa emabega w’omusaayi, omusaayi ogwo gwe gwali obulokozi bwabwe; naye bandigumiridde okuwulira okuvuga kw’embooko y’omusiba w’abaddu singa tebaawonyezebwa mu kikoligo ky’obuddu bw’e Misiri: mu kiseera ekyo Katonda kwe yabawonyeza mu mukono gwa kabaka w’e Misiri. Sirina kusaasira kwa ndowooza egamba nti Katonda akkirira okutulokola, ne alyoka atuleka mu kkomera, nga tuli baddu b’ebibi ebitunywezaako. Nedda; yajja okutuwonya, n’okutuwa obuwanguzi ku busungu bwaffe obubi, ku kwegomba kwaffe, ne ku bukaba bwaffe. Oli Mukristaayo eyeeyita bw’atyo naye nga muddu w’ekibi ekimunywezaako? Bw’oba oyagala okufuna obuwanguzi ku busungu obwo oba okwegomba okwo, weeyongere okumanya Kristo n’okumusemberera. Aleeta obulokozi obw’ebyayita, obw’olwa leero, n’obw’ebijja. “Eyatuwonya; era awonya; era anaatuwonya.” (2 Abakkoolinso i. 10.) Emirundi emeka, ng’abaana ba Isiraeri bwe baatuuka ku Nnyanja Emyufu, gye twaggwaamu amaanyi kubanga buli kimu kyalabika nga kizikiza mu maaso gaffe, emabega waffe, ne wonna okutwetooloola, nga tetumanyi kkubo lya kukwata. Nga Peetero bwe twagamba nti, “Tunaagenda eri ani?” Naye Katonda yajja olw’okutuwonya. Yatuyisa mu Nnyanja Emyufu n’atutuusa mu ddungu, n’aggulawo ekkubo okutuusa mu Nsi Eyasuubizibwa. Naye Kristo si Muwonyi waffe yekka; ye Munnunuzi waffe. Kino kisingako ku kuba Omulokozi waffe. Yatukomyawo. “Mwetunda bwereere; era mulinunulibwa awatali nsimbi.” (Isaaya lii. 3.) “Tetwanunulibwa na bintu ebivunda, ng’effeeza ne zaabu.” (1 Peetero i. 18.) Singa zaabu yandituzze okutununula, tandiyinzizza kutonda nsi omutwalo ogujjudde zaabu? Katonda bwe yamala okununula abaana ba Isiraeri okuva mu buddu bw’e Misiri, n’abayisa mu Nnyanja Emyufu, ne balaga mu ddungu; awo Katonda n’abeera gye bali Ekkubo lyabwe. Nsiima nnyo kubanga Mukama tatulese mu kizikiza ku lw’ekkubo ettuufu. Tewali muntu mulamu abadde awammanga mu kizikiza atayinza kumanya kkubo. “Nze kkubo,” bw’ayogera Kristo. Bwe tugoberera Kristo tunaabeera mu kkubo ettuufu, era tunaabeera n’enjigiriza entuufu. Ani ayinza okukulembera abaana ba Isiraeri mu ddungu nga Katonda Ayinzabyonna yennyini? Yamanya ebinnya n’akabi ak’omu kkubo, n’akulembera abantu mu lugendo lwabwe lwonna olw’omu ddungu okubatuusa mu nsi eyasuubizibwa. Kya mazima nti singa si lwa butakkiriza bwabwe obukolimire, bandisomose ne bayingira mu nsi e Kadesi Baluneya, ne bagitwala, naye baayagala ekintu ekirala okwawukana ku kigambo kya Katonda; bwe batyo ne bazzibwa emabega, ne kibagwanira okutambulatambula mu ddungu okumala emyaka amakumi ana. Nzikiriza nti waliwo enkumi n’enkumi ez’abaana ba Katonda abakyatambulatambula mu ddungu ne kaakano. Mukama abawonyezza mu mukono gw’Omumisiri, era yandibayisizza mu ddungu amangwago n’abatuusa mu Nsi Eyasuubizibwa, singa baali beetegefu kugoberera Kristo. Kristo yajja wano wansi, n’agolola ebifo ebizibu, n’amulisa ebifo eby’ekizikiza, n’agolola ebifo ebikyamu. Bwe tunaaganya okukulemberwa Ye, ne tumugoberera, byonna binaabeera mirembe, na ssanyu, na kuwummula. Mu bitundu eby’oku nsalo, omuntu bw’agenda okuyigga atwala embazzi, n’asalako ebitundu ku bikuta by’emiti ng’ayita mu kibira: kino kiyitibwa “okuteekawo obubonero bw’ekkubo.” Akikola alyoke amanye ekkubo ery’okudda, kubanga tewali luguudo mu bibira ebyo ebikutte. Kristo yajja wano ku nsi; “yateekawo obubonero bw’Ekkubo:” era kaakano nga alinnye waggulu, bwe tunaamugoberera, tunaakuumibwa mu kkubo ettuufu. Nnaakubuulira engeri gy’oyinza okumanyamu oba ogoberera Kristo oba nedda. Singa omuntu akuwaayirizza, oba akusaliddeko omusango mu bukyamu, obayisa nga mukama wo bwe yandikoze? Bw’oba togumira bino n’omwoyo ogw’okwagala n’okusonyiwa, kkanisa zonna n’abaweereza bonna ab’omu nsi tebayinza kukutereeza. “Omuntu yenna bw’ataba na Mwoyo wa Kristo, oyo si wuwe.” (Abaruumi viii. 9.) “Omuntu yenna bw’aba mu Kristo Yesu, aba kitonde kiggya: eby’edda biweddewo; laba, byonna bifuuse biggya.” (2 Abakkoolinso v. 17.) Kristo si kkubo lyaffe lyokka; ye Ekitangaala ku kkubo. Agamba nti, “Nze Kitangaala ky’ensi.” (Yokaana viii. 12; ix. 5; xii. 46.) Ayongera n’agamba nti, “Angoberera taatambulire mu kizikiza, naye anaabanga n’ekitangaala eky’obulamu.” Tekisoboka omusajja oba omukazi yenna agoberera Kristo okutambulira mu kizikiza. Emmeeme yo bw’eba mu kizikiza, ng’ewammanga mu lufu n’olubinja lw’ensi, ka nkubuulire nti kiba lwa kubanga oveewo ku kitangaala ekituufu. Tewali kirala wabula ekitangaala ekiggyawo ekizikiza. Kale abo abatambulira mu kizikiza eky’omwoyo ka basembeze Kristo mu mitima gyabwe: Ye Kitangaala. Nzijukira ekifaananyi kye nnali nfaako ennyo edda; naye kaakano bwe ndabye n’obwegendereza, sandikiwanise mu nnyumba yange okuggyako nga nkyusizza amaaso gaakyo okwolekera ekisenge. Kirangirira Kristo ng’ayimiridde ku luggi, ng’akonkona, ng’akutte ettaala ennene mu mukono gwe. Naye kiba kifaanana ng’owanise ettaala eri enjuba nga bw’owadde emu mu mukono gwa Kristo. Ye Njuba ey’obutuukirivu; era kya mukisa gye tuli okutambulira mu kitangaala ky’enjuba etaliiko bire. Abantu bangi banoonya ekitangaala, n’emirembe, n’essanyu. Tetulagirwa wamu okunoonya ebintu bino. Bwe tusembeza Kristo mu mitima gyaffe, bino byonna binajja byokka. Nzijukira, nga ndi mulenzi, nga ngezaako obutayinza okukwata ekisiikirize kyange. Olunaku lumu nnali ntambula nga nnyolese amaaso gange eri enjuba; ne bwe nnatunula okwetooloola ne ndaba ekisiikirize kyange nga kingoberera. Gye nnasingira okwanguya, gye kyasingira ekisiikirize kyange okungoberera; saayinza kukivaako. Bwe kityo amaaso gaffe bwe gaba geeyolekedde Enjuba ey’obutuukirivu, emirembe n’essanyu binajja awatali kubuusabuusa. Omusajja yaŋŋamba edda nti, “Moody, owulira otya?” Kyali kimaze ebbanga eddene nga sirowoozeeko ku nneewulira yange, ne kimba kya kuyimirira ne nfumiitiriza akaseera, ndyoke ntegeere. Abakristaayo abamu bulijjo balowooza ku nneewulira yaabwe; era kubanga tebeewulira bulungi, balowooza nti essanyu lyabwe liweddewo. Bwe tunaakuuma amaaso gaffe nga geeyolekedde Kristo, ne tumwefaako, tunaggibwa mu kizikiza ne mu buzibu obuyinza okuba nga bukuŋŋaanidde okwetooloola ekkubo lyaffe. Nzijukira nga ndi mu lukuŋŋaana oluvannyuma lw’olutalo olw’obujeemu obunene lwe lwatandika. Olutalo lwali lumaze ng’emyezi mukaaga. Eggye ery’Obukiikakkono lyali liwanguddwa e Bull Run, ddala twali tetulina kya kunyweza wabula okuwangulwa, era kyalabika ng’eggwanga ligenda kusaanawo. Bwe tutyo twali tuweddemu amaanyi nnyo ne tuggwaamu essuubi. Mu lukuŋŋaana luno buli eyayogera okumala akaseera yali afaanana ng’awanise ennanga ye ku muti; era lwali lumu ku nkuŋŋaana ennakuwavu ennyo ze nnali nnaakubaddeko. Ku nkomerero omukadde ow’enviiri enjeru ennungi n’ayimirira okwogera, era amaaso ge ne gamasamasa ddala. “Abavubuka,” bwe yagamba “temwogera ng’abaana ba Kabaka. Newankubadde nga wano kizikiza, mujjukire nti walala waliwo ekitangaala.” N’ayongerayo okugamba nti singa kyandibadde kizikiza mu nsi yonna, waggulu okwetooloola Entebe ey’Obwakabaka kwali kitangaala. Yatugamba nti yali avudde ebuvanjuba, mukwano gwe gy’eyamunnyonnyola engeri gye yali alinnye olusozi okusula ekiro n’okulaba enjuba ng’evaayo. Ekibiina nga kirinnya olusozi, era nga tebannatuuka ku ntikko, omuyaga ne gutandika. Mukwano gwe ono n’agamba omukulembeze nti, “Nnaakivaako; nzizaayo.” Omukulembeze n’amwenyamwenya, n’addamu nti, “Ndowooza tunaatera okuyita waggulu w’omuyaga.” Ne beeyongera; era tekyamala bbanga ne batuuka waggulu ng’ali mu ttebenkevu ng’akawungeezi konna ak’ekyeya. Wansi mu kiwonvu omuyaga ogw’entiisa gwali gukunta; baali bawulira okubwatuka kw’eggulu, n’okulaba okumyansa kw’eraddu; naye byonna byali biteredde ku ntikko y’olusozi. “Bwe kityo, mikwano gyange abato,” omukadde n’ayongera, “newankubadde nga byonna bizikiza okukwetooloola, sembera waggulu katono, ekizikiza kinaddukanga.” Emirundi mingi bwe mba nga ntera okuggwaamu essuubi, ndowooza ku ekyo kye yayogera. Kale bw’oba oli wansi mu kiwonvu wakati mu lufu olukutte n’ekizikiza, sembera waggulu katono; sembera okumpi ne Kristo, era weeyongere okumumanya. Mujjukira Bayibuli nga bw’egamba, nti Kristo bwe yassa omukka ku musaalaba, ekitangaala ky’ensi kyazikizibwa. Katonda yatuma Omwana we okuba ekitangaala ky’ensi; naye abantu tebaayagala kitangaala kubanga kyabanenya ebibi byabwe. Bwe baali bagenda okuzikiza ekitangaala kino, Kristo yagamba ki abayigirizwa be? “Munaabeeranga bajulirwa bange.” (Ebikolwa i. 8.) Alinnye eri waggulu okutwegayiririra; naye ayagala ffe okumwakira wano wansi. “Mmwe muli kitangaala ky’ensi.” (Matayo v. 14.) Kale omulimu gwaffe kwe kwaka; si kufuuwa ekkondeere lyaffe ffennyini abantu balyoke batutunuulire. Kye twagala okukola kwe kulaga Kristo. Bwe tuba n’ekitangaala kyonna, kiba kitangaala kya kwewola. Omuntu yagamba Omukristaayo omuvubuka nti: “Okukyusibwa! ekyo kyonna bulimba bwa mwezi!” N’agamba nti: “Nkwebaza olw’ekifaananyi; omwezi gwewola ekitangaala kyagwo okuva mu njuba; nga naffe bwe tweewola ekyaffe okuva mu Njuba ey’obutuukirivu.” Bwe tuba aba Kristo, tuli wano okumwakira: mu bbanga atunaayita eka eri empeera yaffe. Nzijukira okuwulira eby’omuntu omuzibe w’amaaso eyali atudde ku mabbali g’ekkubo nga alina ettaala okumpi naye. Bwe yabuuzibwa ettaala gye yali agirinira, kubanga yali tasobola kulaba kitangaala, yagamba nti kyali kiri abantu baleme okumwesittalako. Nzikiriza nti abantu abasinga obungi beesittala ku mpisa ezitakwatagana ez’abo abeeyita Bakristaayo okusinga ensonga endala yonna. Ekisinga okwonoona omulimu gwa Kristo okusinga okubuusabuusa kwonna okw’omu nsi, ye ntambula eno enjolo, enfu, ey’empisa ez’okulabika kwokka, okufaanana kw’ensi, okwatula ekyo kye tulina so si. Amaaso g’ensi gatutunuulidde. Ndowooza yali George Fox eyagamba nti buli Omukwaka asaanidde okumulisa ensi okumala mayiro kkumi ezimwetoolodde. Singa fenna twali twaka bulungi ku lwa Mukama waffe, abo abatwetoolodde bandyanguwuddwa okutuukirira, era wandibaddewo oluyoogaano lw’okutendereza olwambuka mu ggulu. Abantu bagamba nti: “Njagala okumanya amazima kye ki.” Wuliriza: “Nze mazima,” bw’ayogera Kristo. (Yokaana xiv. 5.) Bw’oba oyagala okumanya amazima kye ki, manyiira Kristo. Abantu era beemulugunya nti tebalina bulamu. Bangi bagezaako okwewa obulamu obw’omwoyo. Muyinza okweleetera amaanyi n’okwessaamu amasannyalaze, ka twogere bwe tutyo; naye ekivaamu tekiimale bbanga ddene. Kristo yekka y’atonda obulamu. Bw’oba oyagala okuba n’obulamu obw’omwoyo obw’amazima, manyiira Kristo. Bangi bagezaako okuzuukusa obulamu obw’omwoyo nga bagenda mu nkuŋŋaana. Ekyo kiyinza okuba nga kirungi; naye tekiigase, okuggyako nga batuukirira Kristo omulamu. Olwo obulamu bwabwe obw’omwoyo tebuubeere kya kabenje, wabula bunaabeera bwa lubeerera; nga bukulukuta ne bweyongerayo, ne bubala ebibala eri Katonda. Ate Kristo ye Mukuumi waffe. Abayigirizwa abato bangi nnyo batya nti tebaligumira. “Akuuma Isiraeri taabongoote wadde okwebaka.” (Zabbuli cxxi. 4.) Guli mulimu gwa Kristo okutukuuma; era bw’atukuuma tewaabeere kabi ka kugwa. Ndowooza singa Kabaka Vikitoliya yali alina okulabirira Engule y’e Bungereza, omubbi yandigezezzaako okugituukako; naye eterekeddwa mu Kigo ky’e London, era ekuumibwa emisana n’ekiro abaserikale. Eggye ly’e Bungereza lyonna, singa kyetaagisa, lyandiyitiddwa okugikuuma. Naffe tetulina maanyi mu ffe fennyini. Tetwenkanankana na Setaani; alina obumanyirivu obw’emyaka kakaaga. Naye ate tujjukira nti Oyo atabongoota wadde okwebaka ye Mukuumi waffe. Mu Isaaya xli. 10, tusoma nti, “Totya, kubanga ndi naawe; totekemuka, kubanga ndi Katonda wo; nnaakunywezanga; weewaawo nnaakuyambanga; weewaawo nnaakuwaniririranga n’omukono gwange ogwa ddyo ogw’obutuukirivu bwange.” Ne mu Yuda kyokka, olunyiriri 24, tubuulirwa nti “asobola okutukuuma tuleme okugwa.” “Tulina Omuwolereza eri Kitaffe, Yesu Kristo omutuukirivu.” (1 Yokaana ii. 1.) Naye Kristo ye kisingako. Ye Musumba waffe. Guli mulimu gw’omusumba okulabirira endiga, okuziriisa n’okuzikuuma. “Nze Musumba Omulungi;” “Endiga zange ziwulira eddoboozi lyange.” “Nteekawo obulamu bwange ku lw’endiga.” Mu ssuula eyo ey’ekkumi eya Yokaana ey’ekitalo, Kristo akozesa akabonero ak’omuntu emirundi egitasingako amakumi abiri mu munaana, ng’alangirira ky’ali n’ekyo ky’anaakola. Mu lunyiriri 28 agamba nti, “Tezirizikirira n’akamu; so tewali n’omu [muntu] alizisikula mu mukono gwange.” Naye laba nga ekigambo “muntu” kiri mu nnukuta ezisulise. Laba engeri olunyiriri gye lusomebwa ddala: “So tewali n’omu alizisikula mu mukono gwange”—tewali sitaani wadde muntu aliyinza kukikola. Mu kifo ekirala Ekyawandiikibwa kirangirira nti, “Obulamu bwo bukwekeddwa awamu ne Kristo mu Katonda.” (Abakkolosaayi iii. 3.) Nga tuli mirembe era nga tukuumiddwa! Kristo agamba nti, “Endiga zange ziwulira eddoboozi lyange . . . era zingoberera.” (Yokaana x. 27.) Omusajja omu mu buvanjuba yawulira eby’omusumba eyali asobola okuyita endiga ze zonna ku mannya gaazo. N’agenda n’abuuza oba kino kyali kya mazima. Omusumba n’amutwala mu ddundiro endiga gye zaali, n’ayita emu ku zo ku linnya erimu. Endiga emu n’eyimusa amaaso n’eyitaba okuyitibwa, ate endala nga zeeyongera okulya nga tezifaayo. Mu ngeri y’emu n’ayita ng’endiga kkumi na bbiri ne zimwetooloola. Omugenyi n’agamba nti, “Omanya otya emu okuva ku ndala? Zonna zifaanana bumu ddala.” “Kale,” n’agamba, “olaba endiga eri erina engalo eziwundamye katono; eyo endala erina okukukunala; emu eggyibbwako akatundu k’ebyoya; endala erina akabaala akaddugavu; ate endala erina akatundu akaggibbwako ku kutu kwayo.” Omusajja yamanya endiga ze zonna olw’obulema bwazo, kubanga yali talina ndiga ntuukirivu mu kisibo kyonna. Ndowooza Omusumba waffe atumanya mu ngeri y’emu. Omusumba omu ow’omu buvanjuba yali agamba omusajja nti endiga ze zaamanya eddoboozi lye, era nga tewali mugenyi ayinza kuzirimba. Omusajja n’alowooza nti yandyagadde okugezesa ekigambo ekyo. Bw’atyo n’ayambala ekkanzu y’omusumba n’ekiremba, n’atwala omuggo gwe n’agenda eri ekisibo. N’akyusa eddoboozi lye, n’agezaako okwogera nga bw’asobola okufaanana omusumba; naye teyasobola kufuna ndiga n’emu mu kisibo kugimugoberera. N’abuuza omusumba oba endiga ze tezaali zigoberera mugenyi. N’akakibwa okukkiriza nti singa endiga erwala yandigobereredde omuntu yenna. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n’Abakristaayo bangi abeeyita bwe batyo; bwe balwala ne banafuwa mu kukkiriza, banaagoberera omuyigiriza yenna ajja; naye emmeeme bw’eba nga nnamu, omuntu taatwalibwe nsobi na njigiriza za bulimba. Anaamanya oba “eddoboozi” lyogera mazima oba nedda. Anaakitegeera mangu, bw’aba nga ddala ali mu kussa kimu ne Katonda. Katonda bw’atuma omubaka ow’amazima, ebigambo bye binaasangibwa nga byanirizibwa mu mutima gw’Omukristaayo. Kristo Musumba wa kisa. Oyinza olumu okulowooza nti tabadde Musumba wa kisa nnyo gy’oli; oli wansi w’oluga. Kyawandiikibwa nti, “Mukama gw’ayagala amukangavvula, era akuba buli mwana gw’akkiriza.” (Abaebbulaniya xii. 6.) Okuba nti oli wansi w’oluga si bujulizi nti Kristo takwagala. Mukwano gwange omu yafiirwa abaana be bonna. Tewali muntu yandyagadde nnyumba ye okusinga; naye omusujja ogumyufu ne guggyawo omu ku omu; bwe batyo bonna abana oba abataano, omu ku omu, ne bafa. Bakadde abaakosebwa ennaku ne bagenda e Bungereza, ne batambulatambula okuva mu kifo ekimu okudda mu kirala, eyo ne ku ssemazinga. Oluvannyuma ne batuuka mu Siriya. Olunaku lumu ne balaba omusumba ow’omu buvanjuba ng’aserengeta ku mugga, ng’ayita ekisibo kye okusomoka. Endiga ne zisemberera ku lubalama, ne zitunuulira amazzi; naye ne zooleka nga zitya okugayingira, n’atasobola kuzifuula kwanukula kuyita kwe. N’alyoka addira omwana gw’endiga omuto, n’aguteeka wansi w’okumba kumu; n’addira omwana gw’endiga omulala n’aguteeka wansi w’okumba okulala, bw’atyo n’ayingira mu mugga. Endiga enkulu ne zireka okuyimirira nga zitunuulira amazzi: ne zeesuula mu mazzi nga zigoberera omusumba; era mu ddakiika ntono ekisibo kyonna ne kituuka ku ludda olulala; n’azitwala eri amalundiro amaggya era amabisi. Taata ne maama abaafiirwa, nga batunuulira ebibaddewo, ne bawulira nti kyabayigiriza ekintu. Ne balekayo okwemulugunya kubanga Omusumba Omukulu yali atutte abaana baabwe ab’endiga omu ku omu okubatwala mu nsi eri; ne batandika okutunula waggulu n’okusuubira ekiseera lwe balibagoberera abaagalwa be baali baafiirwa. Bw’oba olina abaagalwa abaakukulembera, jjukira nti Omusumba wo akuyita “otekenga omwoyo gwo ku bintu ebiri waggulu.” (Abakkolosaayi iii. 2.) Ka tumubeere beesigwa, ne tumugoberera, nga tukyali mu nsi eno. Era bw’oba tonnamutwala kuba Musumba wo, kikole ku lunaku luno lwennyini. Kristo si bino byonna byokka bye njogeddeko: era ye Mutabaganya waffe, Omutukuza waffe, Atuwa obutuukirivu; ddala, kyandyetaagisa ebitabo bingi okwogera ky’ayagala okuba eri buli mmeeme yonna. Nga nnyalula empapula ezimu, edda nnasoma okunnyonnyola kuno okw’ekitalo okukwata ku Kristo. Simanyi we kwava okusooka; naye kwali kupya bwe kutyo eri emmeeme yange nga nandyagadde okukubawa:— “Kristo ye Kkubo lyaffe; tutambulira mu Ye. Ye Mazima gaffe; tumugwira. Ye Bulamu bwaffe; tuli balamu mu Ye. Ye Mukama waffe; tumulonda okutufuga. Ye Mukama waffe omukulu; tumuweereza. Ye Muyigiriza waffe, atuyigiriza mu kkubo ery’obulokozi. Ye Nnabbi waffe, alaga ebijja. Ye Kabona waffe, eyatutangiririra. Ye Muwolereza waffe, abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okutwegayiririra. Ye Mulokozi waffe, alokola okutuusa ku nkomerero. Ye Mulandira gwaffe; tukula okuva mu Ye. Ye Mmere yaffe; tumulyako. Ye Musumba waffe, atukulembera mu malundiro amalamu. Ye Muzabbibu gwaffe ogw’amazima; tubeera mu Ye. Ye Mazzi ag’Obulamu; tumalawo ennyonta yaffe okuva mu Ye. Ye asinga obulungi mu omutwalo: tumwagala okusinga abalala bonna. Ye ‘okumasamasa kw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe, era ekifaananyi kye ekituufu eky’obuntu bwe;’ tufuba okwoleka ekifaananyi kye. Ye awanirira ebintu byonna; tuwummulira ku Ye. Ye magezi gaffe; atuluŋŋamya. Ye Butuukirivu bwaffe; tusuula obutali butuukirivu bwaffe bwonna ku Ye. Ye Kutukuzibwa kwaffe; tunaga amaanyi gaffe gonna ag’obulamu obutukuvu okuva mu Ye. Ye Kununulibwa kwaffe, atununula okuva mu butali butuukirivu bwonna. Ye Muwonya waffe, awonya endwadde zaffe zonna. Ye Mukwano gwaffe, atuyamba mu byetaago byaffe byonna. Ye Mooluganda waffe, atusanyusa mu buzibu bwaffe.” Kuno kwe kunnyonnyola okulala okulungi: kuva eri Gotthold: “Ku lwange, emmeeme yange eri ng’omwana alumwa enjala n’ennyonta; era neetaaga okwagala kwe n’okubudaabudibwa kwe okummusaamusa. Ndi ndiga ebulubuuta era ebuze; era mmwetaaga ng’omusumba omulungi era omwesigwa. Emmeeme yange eri ng’ejjiba eritidde nga likomberezebwa akamunye; era neetaaga ebiwundu bye okuba obuddukiro. Ndi muzabbibu munafu; era neetaaga omusaalaba gwe okugukwatako, n’okwezingako. Ndi mwonoonyi; era neetaaga obutuukirivu bwe. Ndi bwereere era ndi mwereere; era neetaaga obutukuvu bwe n’obutaliiko musango okuba ekibikka. Simanyi; era neetaaga okuyigiriza kwe: ndi mwangu era musirusiru; era neetaaga okuluŋŋamizibwa kw’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu. Mu mbeera yonna, era mu kiseera kyonna, siyinza kubaawo awatali Ye. Nsaba? Ye ateekwa okunkubiriza, n’okunneegayiririra. Mpawaabirwa Setaani mu mbuga ya Katonda? Ye ateekwa okuba Omuwolereza wange. Ndi mu kubonaabona? Ye ateekwa okuba Omuyambi wange. Njigganyizibwa ensi? Ye ateekwa okunnwanirira. Bwe nvaabulwa, Ye ateekwa okuba Omuwanirizi wange; bwe mba nfa, obulamu bwange: bwe mba nvunda mu ntaana, Okuzuukira kwange. Kale, nnaasinga okwawukana n’ensi yonna, ne byonna bye erimu, okusinga okwawukana naawe, Omulokozi wange. Era, Katonda yeebazibwe! Mmanyi nti naawe, toyinza wadde toyagala kubaawo awatali nze. Oli mugagga; nga nze ndi mwavu. Olina obungi; nga nze ndi mwetaavu. Olina obutuukirivu; nga nze ebibi. Olina omwenge n’amafuta; nga nze ebiwundu. Olina ebiwooma n’ebisaamusa; nga nze enjala n’ennyonta. Kale nkozese, Omulokozi wange, mu buli kigendererwa, era mu buli ngeri, gy’oyinza okwetaaga. Guno gwe mutima gwange omwavu, ekibya ekyereere; kijjuze ekisa kyo. Eno y’emmeeme yange ey’ekibi era eteganyizibbwa; gizuukuse ogisaamuse n’okwagala kwo. Twala omutima gwange gube ky’obeeramu; akamwa kange okusaasaanya ekitiibwa ky’erinnya lyo; okwagala kwange n’amaanyi gange gonna, olw’okukulaakulanya abantu bo abakkiriza; era toganya bunywevu n’obwesige bw’okukkiriza kwange kukendeera—olwo mu biseera byonna nsobozesebwe okwogera okuva ku mutima nti. ‘Yesu anneetaaga, era nange mmwetaaga; bwe tutyo tuba tusaanyi omu ku omu.’”

fields.title: Okudda Ennyuma
fields.body_html:
“Ndiwonya okudda kwabwe ennyuma; ndibaagala lwa buntu bwange; kubanga obusungu bwange bubavuddeko.”—Koseya 14:4.

Waliwo ebika bibiri eby’abaddayo ennyuma. Abamu tebaakyusibwa mutima n’olutono: baayita mu mukolo gw’okwegatta ku kibiina eky’Ekikristaayo ne beeyita abaddayo ennyuma; naye, bwe nnyinza okwogera bwe ntyo, tebaali “bagenze mu maaso.” Bayinza okwogera ku kudda ennyuma; naye ddala tebaazaalibwa mulundi ogwokubiri. Beetaaga okuyisibwa mu ngeri ya njawulo okuva ku abo abaddayo ennyuma mu butuufu—abo abaazaalibwa mu nsigo etayonooneka, naye ne bakyama. Kye twagala kwe kukomyawo bano mu kkubo lye limu lye baayitamu bwe baaleka okwagala kwabwe okusooka.

Kyuka odde ku Zabbuli 85:5. Awo osoma nti: “Olinaakusunguwalira emirembe gyonna? Olyongera okwongera obusungu bwo emirembe n’emirembe? Toliddamu kutuzzaamu amaanyi, abantu bo balyoke basanyukire mu ggwe? Tulage okusaasira kwo, ai Mukama, otuwe obulokozi bwo.” Kaakano yongera olabe: “Ndiwuliriza Katonda Mukama ky’anaayogera: kubanga anaayogera emirembe eri abantu be, n’eri abatukuvu be; naye baleme kudda nate mu busirusiru” (olunyiriri 8).

Tewali kintu na kimu kiyinza kuyamba abaddayo ennyuma nga bwe kiba nga bakwatagana n’Ekigambo kya Katonda; era gye bali, Endagaano Enkadde ejjudde obuyambi nga bwe kiri n’Endagaano Empya. Ekitabo kya Yeremiya kirimu ebifo eby’ekitalo eri abo abawaba. Kye twagala kwe kuleeta abaddayo ennyuma bawulire Katonda Mukama ky’anaayogera.

Tunuulira akaseera Yeremiya 6:10. “Ani gwe nnaayogera, ne mmulabula, balyoke bawulire? laba, amatu gaabwe tegakomolebwa, so tebayinza kuwuliriza: laba, ekigambo kya Mukama kibavuma; tebakisanyukira.” Ekyo kye kifaananyi ky’abaddayo ennyuma. Tebasanyukira n’akatono ekigambo kya Katonda. Naye twagala okubakomyawo, Katonda alyoke akwate okutu kwabwe. Soma okuva ku lunyiriri olw’ekkumi n’ennya: “Bawonyezza n’olutono ekiwundu ky’omuwala w’abantu bange, nga boogera nti Mirembe, mirembe; so nga tewali mirembe. Baakwatibwa ensonyi bwe baakola eby’ekivve? nedda, tebaakwatibwa nsonyi n’akatono, so tebaayinza kuswala: kyebaliva bagwira wamu n’abo abagwa: mu kiseera lwe ndibakyalira baligwa wansi, bw’ayogera Mukama. Bw’ati bw’ayogera Mukama nti Muyimirire mu makubo, mulabe, mubuulize amakubo ag’edda, we lyali ekkubo eddungi, mutambulire omwo; mulyoke muwummulize emyoyo gyammwe. Naye ne boogera nti Tetuutambulire mwo. Era nabateekerawo abakuumi nga njogera nti Muwulirize eddoboozi ly’ekkondeere. Naye ne boogera nti Tetuuwulirize.”

Ekyo kye kyali embeera y’Abayudaaya bwe baali baddayo ennyuma. Baali bavudde mu makubo ag’edda. Era eyo y’embeera y’abaddayo ennyuma. Baavudde ku kitabo ekyo ekirungi eky’edda. Adamu ne Kaawa baagwa olw’obutawuliriza kigambo kya Katonda. Tebaakkiriza kigambo kya Katonda; naye ne bakkiriza omukemi. Eyo y’engeri abaddayo ennyuma gye bagwamu—olw’okuva ku kigambo kya Katonda.

Mu Yeremiya 2 tusanga Katonda ng’abeegayirira nga kitaawe w’omwana bw’andyegayiridde omwana we. “Bw’ati bw’ayogera Mukama nti Bakadde bammwe obutali butuukirivu ki bwe baalaba mu nze, ne banvaako, ne bagoberera obutaliimu, ne bafuuka abataliimu? . . . Kyendiva njolekera okuwoza nammwe, bw’ayogera Mukama; era n’abaana b’abaana bammwe ndibawoza . . . Kubanga abantu bange bakoze ebibi bibiri: banvuddeko, nze Nsulo y’amazzi amalamu, ne beesimira ebidiba, ebidiba ebyatika, ebitayinza kukwata mazzi.”

Kaakano waliwo ekintu kimu kye twagala okujjukiza abaddayo ennyuma; era kye kino, nti Mukama teyabaleka; wabula bo be baamuleka! Mukama teyabavaako; wabula bo be baamuvaako! Era kino, awatali nsonga yonna! Agamba nti, “Bakadde bammwe obutali butuukirivu ki bwe baalaba mu nze, ne banvaako?” Katonda si y’omu leero nga bwe yali bwe wajja gy’ali okusooka? Katonda akyusizza? Abantu batera okulowooza nti Katonda akyusizza; naye ommusango guli ku bo. Ggwe eyadda ennyuma, nandikubuuzza nti, “Butali butuukirivu ki obuli mu Katonda, ekikuleese okumuleka n’okumuvaako ewala?” Ggwe, bw’ayogera, weesimidde ebidiba ebyatika ebitakwata mazzi. Ensi teyinza kumatiza obuzaale obuggya. Tewali luzzi lwa nsi luyinza kumatiza omwoyo ogufuuse omugabe mu buzaale obw’omu ggulu. Ekitiibwa, obugagga n’amasanyu g’ensi eno tebijja kumatiza abo abaakomba amazzi ag’obulamu ne bawaba, nga banoonya okuwummuzibwa mu nzizi z’ensi. Enzizi z’ensi zijja kukalira. Teziyinza kumatiza ennyonta ey’omwoyo.

Nate mu lunyiriri olw’amakumi asatu mu bubiri: “Omuwala ayinza okwerabira ebyokwewunda bye, oba omugole ebyambalo bye? naye abantu bange banneerabidde, ennaku ezitabalika.” Ogwo gwe musango Katonda gw’aleeta ku eyadda ennyuma. “Banneerabidde, ennaku ezitabalika.”

Emirundi mingi neewuunyisizza abawala abato bwe mbagamba nti, “Mukwano gwange, olowooza ku bikomo byo eby’omu matu okusinga bw’olowooza ku Mukama.” Okuddamu kubadde nti, “Nedda, sikola bwe ntyo.” Naye bwe mbabuuzza nti, “Toweeraliikirira singa okimu kikubula; era toligenda kukinoonya?” okuddamu kubadde nti, “Wamma, weewaawo, ndowooza nti nandikoze bwe ntyo.” Naye newaakubadde nga baali bavudde ku Mukama, tekyabaleetera kweraliikirira n’akatono; so tebaamunoonya balyoke bamulabe.

Bangi abaali edda mu bumu ne mu njogeraganya eya buli lunaku ne Mukama kaakano balowooza ku ngoye zaabwe n’ebyokwewunda byabwe okusinga bwe balowooza ku myoyo gyabwe egy’omuwendo! Okwagala tekwagala kwerabirwa. Bannyina bandimenyeddwa emitima singa abaana baabwe babaleka ne batawandiika kigambo n’akamu oba okuweereza ekijjukizo ky’okwagala kwabwe; era Katonda yeegayiririra abaddayo ennyuma nga muzadde bw’ayegayiririra abaagalwa be abawabye. Agezaako okubawugula bakomewo. Abuuza nti, “Nkoze ki ekibaleese okuva ku nze?”

Ebigambo eby’obwagazi era eby’okwagala okusinga byonna ebisangibwa mu Bayibuli yonna biva eri Yakuwa nga bigenda eri abo abaamuleka awatali nsonga. Yer. 2:19.

Wuliriza engeri gy’awoza nabo: (Yer. 2:19.) “Obubi bwo bwennyini bulikukangavvula, n’okudda kwo ennyuma kulikunenya; kimanye kale, olabe, nga kibi era nga kya bulumi, ggwe okuva ku Mukama Katonda wo, n’okutya kwange nga tekuli mu ggwe, bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda w’eggye.”

Sikuba mu kamwa bwe njogera nti ndabye abaddayo ennyuma nga bakomawo mu bikumi; era mbabuuzza oba tebalaba ng’okuleka Mukama kibi era kya bulumi. Toyinza kusanga eyadda ennyuma mu butuufu, eyamanya Mukama, atalikkiriza nti kibi era kya bulumi okumuvaako; era simanyi lunyiriri lulala olw’okukozesebwa okusinga olwo okukomyawo abawabye. Kisobole okukukomyawo bw’oba obadde owabye mu nsi ey’ewala.

Tunuulira Lutti. Teyakiraba nga kibi era kya bulumi? Yamala emyaka amakumi abiri mu Sodoma, naye teyafuula muntu n’omu okukyuka. Yagenda bulungi mu maaso g’ensi. Abantu bandikugambye nti yali omu ku basajja abakulembeze era abagwana okusinga mu Sodoma yonna. Naye zisanze! zisanze! yazikiriza ab’omu maka ge. Era kya nnaku okulaba eyo eyadda ennyuma omukadde ng’atambula mu nguudo za Sodoma mu ttumbi, ng’amaze okulabula abaana be, nabo ne baziba amatu gaabwe.

Sirabanga musajja ne mukazi we nga badda ennyuma awatali kuzikiririza ddala abaana baabwe. Balikola eby’eddiini okuba eby’okusekererwa era balivvoola bazadde baabwe: “Obubi bwo bwennyini bulikukangavvula; n’okudda kwo ennyuma kulikunenya!” Dawudi teyakiraba bwe kityo? Mulabe, ng’akaaba nti, “Ai mutabani wange Abusaalomu, mwana wange, mwana wange Abusaalomu! singa Katonda yandindese nfe ku lulwo; ai Abusaalomu, mwana wange, mwana wange!” Ndowooza nga okuzikirira kw’omwana we, so si kufa kwe, kwe kwaleeta obuyinike buno.

Nzijukira nga nnina emyaka egiyise nga njogera n’omusajja omukadde okutuusa ttumbi nga liyise. Yali amaze emyaka ng’awaba ku nsozi enkalu ez’ekibi. Ekiro ekyo yayagala okukomawo. Twasaba, ne tusaba, ne tusaba, okutuusa ekitangaala bwe kyamwakira; n’agenda ng’asanyuka. Ekiro ekyaddirira yatuula mu maaso gange nga mbuulira, era ndowooza nti sirabanga muntu n’omu ng’alabika nga munakuwavu era omunyiivu bwe ntyo mu bulamu bwange bwonna. Yangoberera mu kisenge ky’okwebuuza. “Kiki ekikuluma?” ne mmubuuza. “Eriiso lyo liva ku Mulokozi? Okubuusabuusa kwo kukomyewo?” “Nedda; si ekyo,” n’ayogera. “Saagenze mu bizimbe, wabula mmaze olunaku luno lwonna nga nkyalira abaana bange. Bonna bafumbiddwa era bali mu kibuga kino. Nagenda okuva mu nnyumba emu okutuuka mu ndala, naye tewaali n’omu atannyooma. Lwe lunaku olusinga obuddugavu mu bulamu bwange. Nzuukuse ne ndaba kye nkoze. Nazaala abaana bange ne mbayingiza mu nsi; kaakano siyinza kubaggyamu.” Mukama yali amuzzeeko essanyu ery’obulokozi bwe; naye ebibi ebyava mu kwonoona kwe byali biwo. Oyinza okuyita mu bye wayitamu; era oyinza okusanga ebifaananyi ng’ebyo nga biddibwamu emirundi n’emirundi. Bangi abajja mu kibuga kyammwe emyaka egiyise nga baweereza Katonda, mu kugaggawala kwabwe bamwerabidde: era abaana baabwe ab’obulenzi n’ab’obuwala bali ludda wa? Ndaga kitaawe ne nnyina abaleka Mukama ne badda mu bintu eby’obwavu eby’ensi; era nnaba nkyamye singa abaana baabwe tebali mu kkubo eddene erigenda mu kuzikirira.

Nga bwe twagala okuba abeesigwa, tulabula abaddayo ennyuma bano. Kabonero ka kwagala okulabula ku bulabe. Tuyinza okutwalibwa ng’abalabe okumala akaseera; naye mikwano mituufu be bayimusa eddoboozi ery’okulabula. Isiraeri teyalina mukwano mutuufu okusinga Musa. Mu Yeremiya Katonda yawa abantu be nnabbi akaaba amaziga okubakomyawo gy’ali; naye ne bagaana Katonda. Beerabira Katonda eyabaggya mu Misiri, era eyabakulembera mu ddungu okubatuusa mu nsi ey’endagaano. Mu kugaggawala kwabwe baamwerabira ne bakyuka. Mukama yali abagambye ekigenda okubaawo. (Ma. 28.) Era laba ekyabaawo. Kabaka eyanyooma ekigambo kya Katonda yawambibwa Nebukadduneeza, n’abaana be ne baleetebwa mu maaso ge era buli omu n’attibwa: amaaso ge ne gaggibwamu; n’asibibwa mu njegere ez’ekikomo n’asuulibwa mu kkomera mu Babulooni. (2 Bak. 25:7.) Bw’atyo bwe yakungula bye yasiga. Mazima kibi era kya bulumi okudda ennyuma, naye Mukama ayagala okukukomyawo n’obubaka bw’Omulimu gwe.

Mu Yeremiya 8:5, tusoma nti: “Kale abantu bano ab’omu Yerusaalemi lwaki baddayo ennyuma olw’okudda ennyuma okutaggwaawo? Banywerera ku bukuusa; bagaana okukomawo.” Ekyo Mukama kye yaleeta ku bo. “Bagaana okukomawo.” “Nawuliriza ne mpulira; naye tebaayogera bulungi: tewaali muntu n’omu eyeenenyeza obubi bwe, ng’ayogera nti, Nkoze ki? Buli omu yakyukira mu kkubo lye, ng’embalaasi bw’efubutuka mu lutalo. Weewaawo, enkuluku ey’omu ggulu emanyi ebiseera byayo ebyalagirwa; n’ejjiba n’akasaayi n’akataayi bikwata ekiseera eky’okujja kwabyo; naye abantu bange tebamanyi kusala musango kwa Mukama.”

Kaakano tunuulira: “Nawuliriza ne mpulira; naye tebaayogera bulungi.” Tewali kyoto kya maka! Tewali kusoma Bayibuli! Tewali kusaba mu kisenge! Katonda akutama okuwulira; naye abantu be bakyuse! Bwe wabaawo eyadda ennyuma ng’eyeenenya, ng’ayagala okusonyiyibwa n’okukomezebwawo, tojja kusanga bigambo bya kwagala okusinga ebisangibwa mu Yeremiya 3:12: “Genda, olangirire ebigambo bino eri obukiikakkono, oyogere nti, Komawo, ggwe Isiraeri eyadda ennyuma, bw’ayogera Mukama; sirireetera busungu bwange kubagwako: kubanga ndi wa kisa, bw’ayogera Mukama, so sirikuuma busungu bwange emirembe gyonna.” Kaakano weetegereze: “Kyokka kkiriza obutali butuukirivu bwo, nga wayonoona ku Mukama Katonda wo, n’osaasaanya amakubo go eri abagwira wansi wa buli muti omugimu, so temwagondera ddoboozi lyange, bw’ayogera Mukama. Mukomewo, mmwe abaana abaddayo ennyuma, bw’ayogera Mukama; kubanga nze mufumbo wammwe”—lowooza ku Katonda ng’ajja n’ayogera nti, “Nze mufumbo wammwe!—era ndibaggya omu mu kibuga, n’ababiri mu kika, ne mbaleeta e Sayuuni.”

“Kyokka kkiriza obutali butuukirivu bwo.” Emirundi emeka gye nnimusize olunyiriri olwo eri eyadda ennyuma! “Kkiriza” bwo; era Katonda ayogera nti Ndikusonyiwa. Nzijukira omusajja bwe yambuuza nti, “Ani yakyogera ekyo? Kiri awo?” Ne mmulaga olunyiriri, “Kyokka kkiriza obutali butuukirivu bwo;” omusajja n’afukamira, n’akaaba nti, “Katonda wange, nyonoonye”; Mukama n’amuzza mu kifo ekyo era mu kiseera ekyo. Bw’oba owabye, ayagala okomewo.

Ayogera mu kifo ekirala nti, “Ai Efulayimu, nkukole ki? Ai Yuda, nkukole ki? kubanga obulungi bwammwe buli ng’ekire eky’oku makya, era ng’omusulo ogw’amangu ago bwe guggwaawo” (Koseya 6:4). Okusaasira kwe n’okwagala kwe kya kitalo!

Mu Yeremiya 3:22: “Mukomewo, mmwe abaana abaddayo ennyuma, ne nze ndiwonya okudda kwammwe ennyuma. Laba, tujja gy’oli; kubanga ggwe Mukama Katonda waffe.” Ateeka bugambo mu kamwa k’eyadda ennyuma. Kkomawo bukomawo; era, bw’onookomawo, alikwaniriza n’ekisa era alikwagala lwa buntu bwe.

Mu Koseya 14:1, 2, 4: “Ai Isiraeri, komawo eri Mukama Katonda wo; kubanga ogudde olw’obutali butuukirivu bwo. Mutwale ebigambo, mukyuke eri Mukama (ateeka ebigambo mu kamwa ko): mumugambe nti, Ggyawo obutali butuukirivu bwonna, otwanirize n’ekisa; bwe tutyo tuliwaayo ennyana ez’emimwa gyaffe . . . Ndiwonya okudda kwabwe ennyuma, ndibaagala lwa buntu bwange, kubanga obusungu bwange bumuvuddeko.” Weetegereze ekyo, Kyuka! Kyuka!! Kyuka!!! kuvuga mu bifo bino byonna.

Kaakano, bw’oba owabye, jjukira nti ggwe wamuleka, so si ye eyakuleka. Oteekwa okuva mu bunnya bw’eyadda ennyuma mu ngeri y’emu gye wayingira. Era bw’oyita mu kkubo lye limu lye wayitamu bwe wava ku Mukama, olimusanga kaakano, awo w’oli.

Singa twayisa Kristo nga bwe twayisa mukwano gwaffe yenna ow’oku nsi, tetwandimulese; era tewandibaddewo eyadda ennyuma. Singa mbadde mu kibuga okumala wiiki emu, sandirowooza kugendayo nga sinnakwatako mikono giva ku mikwano gye nfunye, ne mbagamba nti “Weeraba.” Nnandivumiddwa mu mazima singa ntutte eggaali y’omukka ne ngenda nga siyogedde kigambo eri n’omu. Okukaaba kwandibaddewo nti, “Kiki ekigenze?” Naye wali owuliddeko eyadda ennyuma ng’asiibula Mukama Yesu Kristo nti “Weeraba”; ng’ayingira mu kisenge kye n’ayogera nti, “Mukama Yesu, nkumanyi emyaka kkumi, amakumi abiri, oba amakumi asatu: naye nkooye okukuweereza; ekikoligo kyo tekyangu, so n’omugugu gwo teguwewuka; kyenva ndda mu nsi, eri ebbinika z’ennyama ez’e Misiri. Weeraba, Mukama Yesu! Weeraba”? Wali okiwuliddeko ekyo? Nedda; tokiwuliddeko, so toligenda kukiwulira. Nkugamba nti, bw’oyingira mu kisenge n’oggalawo ensi n’okwatagana ne Mukama toyinza kumuleka. Olulimi lw’omutima gwo lulyogera nti, “Ani gwe tunaagenda,” wabula ggwe? “Ggwe olina ebigambo eby’obulamu obutaggwaawo” (Yok. 6:68). Toyinza kudda mu nsi singa omuyisa mu ngeri eyo. Naye wamuleka n’oddukira ewala. Omwerabidde ennaku ezitabalika. Komawo leero; nga bw’oli! Malirira nti toowummulenga okutuusa Katonda lw’alikuzzaako essanyu ery’obulokozi bwe.

Omusajja omu mu Cornwall lumu yasisinkana Omukristaayo mu luguudo gwe yamanya nti yali adda ennyuma. Yamusemberera, n’ayogera nti, “Ntegeeza, tewali njawukana wakati wo ne Mukama Yesu?” Omusajja yakutamya omutwe gwe, n’ayogera nti, “Weewaawo.” “Kale,” omusajja n’ayogera, “akukoze ki?” Okuddamu kw’ekyo kwali mukoka gwa maziga.

Mu Okubikkulirwa 2:4, 5, tusoma nti: “Naye nnina ekintu naawe, kubanga waleka okwagala kwo okusooka. Kale jjukira gye wava ng’ogudde; weenenye, okole emirimu egisooka: oba si ekyo, ndijja gy’oli mangu, ne nzigya ekikondo kyo eky’ettaala mu kifo kyakyo, bw’otoyenenya.” Njagala kukukuuma eri ensobi abantu abamu gye bakola ku “kukola emirimu egisooka.” Bangi balowooza nti balina okuddamu okufuna okumanya kwe kimu nate. Ekyo kikutte enkumi n’enkumi emyezi mingi awatali mirembe; kubanga baabadde balindirira okuzzibwawo kw’okumanya kwabwe okusooka. Toolabe okumanya kwe kimu nga bwe wafuna bwe wasooka okujja eri Mukama. Katonda teyeeddiŋŋana. Tewali bantu babiri mu bantu obukadde bw’ensi abafaanagana oba abalowooza kimu. Oyinza okwogera nti toyinza kwawula bantu babiri; naye bw’omanyagana nabo bulungi oyinza mangu okwawula enjawulo. Bwe kityo, tewali muntu n’omu aliba n’okumanya kwe kimu omulundi ogwokubiri. Katonda bw’anaazza essanyu lye eri omwoyo gwo, muleke akikole mu ngeri ye. Tolambika Katonda kkubo lya kukuwaamu omukisa. Toosuubire kumanya kwe kimu kwe wafuna emyaka ebiri oba amakumi abiri egiyise. Olifuna okumanya okuggya, era Katonda alikukwatamu mu ngeri ye ye. Bw’oyatula ebibi byo n’omubuulira nti owabye n’oleka ekkubo ery’ebiragiro bye alikuzzaako essanyu ery’obulokozi bwe.

Njagala okusikula obwongo bwo eri engeri Peetero gye yagwiramu; era ndowooza nti kumpi bonna bagwa mu ngeri y’emu. Njagala okuyimusa eddoboozi ery’okulabula eri abo abatannagwa. “Alowooza nti ayimiridde yeekuume aleme okugwa” (1 Bak. 10:12). Emyaka amakumi abiri mu etaano egiyise—era mu myaka etaano egyasooka nga naakayenkanyizibwa—nnali njogera nti singa mba nsobola okuyimirira emyaka amakumi abiri sandigobye kugwa. Naye gy’osemberera Omusaalaba, olutalo lwe lweyongera okukaluba. Setaani agenderera waggulu. Yagenda mu abo ekkumi n’ababiri; n’alonda Omuwanika—Yuda Isukalyoti, n’Omutume Omukulu—Peetero. Abasajja abasinga obungi abagwa bagwa ku ludda olw’empisa yaabwe olusinga amaanyi. Bantegeeza nti oludda olwokka ekigo ky’e Edinburgh kye kyawangulirwako lwe lwali oludda enjazi we zaali entabike ennyo, era abakuumi we baalowoolezanga nga bali mu bukuumi. Omuntu yenna bw’alowooza nti wa maanyi okuyinza okuziyiza Setaani ku kifo kyonna, akyetaaga okukuuma okw’enjawulo, kubanga omukemi ajja mu kkubo eryo.

Ibulayimu ayimirira, ng’omukulu ow’omu maka ag’okukkiriza; era abaana ab’okukkiriza bayinza okwogerwako nga banoonyereza olulyo lwabwe eri Ibulayimu: naye wansi mu Misiri yeegaana mukazi we. (Lub. 12.) Musa yamanyibwanga olw’obuwombeefu bwe; naye yaziyizibwa okuyingira mu nsi ey’endagaano olw’ekikolwa kimu eky’obwangu n’okwogera, Mukama bwe yamugamba okwogera n’olwazi ekibiina n’ebisolo byabwe balyoke banywe amazzi. “Muwulire kaakano, mmwe abajeemu; tulibaggya amazzi mu lwazi luno?” (Kubala 20:10).

Eriya yamanyibwanga olw’obuvumu: naye n’agenda olugendo lwa lunaku mu ddungu ng’omutiitiizi n’yeekweka wansi w’omuti omwoloola, ng’asaba yekka nti afe, olw’obubaka bwe yafuna okuva eri omukazi. (1 Bak. 19.) Twekuume. Ka abe muntu ki—ayinza okuba ng’ali mu kkubiro—naye bwe yeegulumiza aligwa ddala. Ffe abagoberezi ba Kristo twetaaga bulijjo okusaba tufuulibwe abawombeefu, era tukuumibwe abawombeefu. Katonda yaleetera amaaso ga Musa okumasamasa abantu abalala ne gasobola okuraba; naye Musa yennyini teyamanya nti amaaso ge gamasamasa, era omuntu gy’asingira okuba omutukuvu mu mutima gy’alyeyongera okulabika eri ensi ey’ebweru mu bulamu bwe obwa buli lunaku ne mu njogera ye. Abantu abamu boogera ku ngeri gye bawombeka; naye bwe baba n’obuwombeefu obw’amazima tewaabeewo kyetaagisa okubulangirira. Tekyetaagisa. Ekitangaala eky’omu nnyanja tekikuba ngoma oba kufuuwa ndeere okulangirira nti ekitangaala kiri kumpi: kyekakasa kyokka. Bwe kityo bwe tuba n’ekitangaala eky’amazima munda yaffe kiryeraga kyokka. Si abo abaleeta oluyoogaano oluyitirivu be balina okutya Katonda okusingayo. Waliwo akagga, oba “akato” nga Abasukotti bwe bakayita, wamu w’embeera we ntuula; era oluvannyuma lw’enkuba ennyingi oyinza okuwulira okuwuluguuta kw’amazzi gaako okuva ewala: naye ka wajje ennaku entono ez’obudde obulungi, akagga kaba kumpi kusirika. Naye waliwo omugga kumpi n’ennyumba yange, gwe ntawuliddeko okukulukuta mu bulamu bwange, nga gukulukuta mu lugendo lwagwo oluwanvu era olw’ekitiibwa omwaka gwonna. Twandibadde n’okwagala kwa Katonda okungi munda yaffe ne kulabika awatali kulangirira kwaffe okw’oluyoogaano.

Ekituula ekisooka mu kugwa kwa Peetero kwali kwesiga yekka. Mukama yamulabula. Mukama yagamba nti: “Simooni, Simooni, laba, Setaani abasabye, alyoke abawewe ng’eŋŋaano: naye nze nkusabidde, okukkiriza kwo kuleme okuggwaawo” (Luk. 22:31, 32). Naye Peetero yagamba nti: “Neetegese okugenda naawe, ne mu kkomera ne mu kufa.” “Newaakubadde nga bonna balyesittala ku lulwo, nze siryesittala emirembe gyonna.” (Mat. 26:33.) “Yakobo ne Yokaana, n’abalala, bayinza okukuleka; naye ggwe oyinza okunneesiga!” Naye Mukama yamulabula: “Nkugamba, Peetero, enkoko terikookolima leero, nga tonnankana nga onneegaana emirundi esatu.” (Luk. 22:34.)

Newaakubadde nga Mukama yamunenya, Peetero yagamba nti yali yeeteeseteese okumugoberera okutuuka mu kufa. Okwenyumiriza okwo emirundi mingi kubeera omukulembeze gw’okugwa. Katutambule n’obuwombeefu n’obukkakkamu. Tulina omukemi omukulu; era, mu ssaawa etakuumiddwa, tuyinza okwesittala ne tugwa ne tuleeta ekivve ku Kristo.

Ekituula ekiddirira mu kugwa kwa Peetero kwali kwe kugenda okwebaka. Setaani bw’asobola okusuiza Ekkanisa otulo akola omulimu gwe okuyita mu bantu ba Katonda bennyini. Mu kifo ky’okutunula essaawa emu entono mu Gesusemane, Peetero yagwa otulo, Mukama n’amubuuza nti, “Kale, temwayinza kutunula nange essaawa n’emu?” (Mat. 26:40.) Ekiddirira kwe kuti, yalwana n’amaanyi ag’omubiri. Mukama yaddamu okumunenya n’ayogera nti, “Abo abakwata ekitala balizikirira n’ekitala.” (Mat. 26:52.) Yesu yali ateekwa okumenya Peetero kye yali akoze. Ekiddirira, “yagoberera nga ali wala.” Kigere ku kigere agenda ewala. Kya nnaku omwana wa Katonda ng’agoberera nga ali wala. Bw’omulaba ng’atabagana ne mikwano gy’ensi, era ng’asuula obuyinza bwe ku ludda oluli obubi, aba agoberera ng’ali wala; era tekiryonoona bbanga nga erinnya ery’edda ery’ekika teriswazibwa, era Yesu Kristo aliwundibwa mu nnyumba ya mikwano gye. Omuntu, olw’ekyokulabirako kye, alireetera abalala okwesittala n’okugwa.

Ekiddirira—Peetero afuuka ow’oluganda era mukwano gw’abalabe ba Kristo.
